description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located location.

reviews.text: Murat is a helpful host. He communicates well. The accommodation is as seen in the photos. Very simple, 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom. Hot water, AC makes the place more comfortable.

Murat’s place was super central, we were able to walk to all the main sights within 15-20 mins. The tram wasn’t far either, it was only 10 min walk up the hill.
The room was clean and easy going, though the bathroom’s ventilation could have been better.
There is a cute fruit stall just outside the house and lots of restaurants to eat at. Walking out of the house everyday was always a surprise because there was so much action and activity happening.
This place is perfect if you were here for a few nights, though more than a few could be a bit hard because the room isn’t sound proof and you’ll hear lots of noises coming from people walking in and out of the stairway and on the street.
Murat was super responsive and helped us with everything we needed - we really appreciated that!
Overall we had a wonderful time in Murat’s place and it had just everything we needed for the duration of our stay.
Thank you Murat!

Murat Bey'e misafirperverliği ve ilgili iletişimi için teşekkür ederim, sorularıma detaylı yanıt verdi.Evin konumu merkeziydi bu sebeple evi bulmakta bir zorluk yaşamadım aksine kolaylıkla buldum. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğünü gibiydi ve temizdi. Tekrar konaklamak isteyeceğim yerlerden biri oldu.
Merkezi bir konumda, oldukça temiz, gayet güzel bir deneyimdi. Ev sahibi hızlı cevap verdi ve ilgiliydi.
Çok rahat ve tertemiz bir yerdi. Özellikle check-in ve check-out süreci oldukça net ve kullanışlıydı. Herkese tavsiye etmek isterim.

description:
Experience the perfect stay in Istanbul's historic peninsula!

This booking offers a fully equipped authentic apartment on a tranquil street in Karakoy with proximity to the Galata Port, Istanbul Modern Museum, vibrant nightlife, and public transit options, all just minutes away.

With a coffee shop to start your day on the ground floor, the famous Gümrük Restaurant serving delightful meals around the corner and our daily cleaning and concierge services, we ensure your vacation is memorable!

reviews.text: Such a great location, was super easy to walk to things on both sides of Galata Bridge. The space was comfortable and clean, and the shower was awesome. The instructions to find the building were confusing but the host responded right away and got us sorted out and into the building in minutes. It was great!

Great location! Private and somewhat secluded. The place is exactly as described. Outside noise is a factor. I expected to sleep and bathe here since Istanbul has so much to do so you can’t expect to stay here when there is so much to explore. There is lots of activity outside that brings some noise. The door lock required a battery change, and when I mentioned it to the host I received a typical answer that you would expect from a disengaged host. Next time I will use one of the many hotels in the area.

I had such a nice time staying here during my trip to Istanbul. Karaköy is the perfect location because it's close to Sultanahmet where you will inevitably do a lot of trips to museums early on in your visit to Istanbul. I preferred staying in Karaköy over Cihangir, and wish I was here the entirety of my trip. You can also get delicious fish wraps in Karaköy, and it is close to Galataport where you can do some quick shopping (I bought nice fragrance from Atelier Rebul).
The airbnb itself was so cute, with ~12 foot high ceilings, lots of space for one or two, a huuuuuge bathroom and bed. I took photos so I could take some inspiration for my future apartment haha. It was a very comfortable stay right by the bus station too. Honestly loved my time here so much and would come back without a doubt.

Great stay here! Would definitely recommend. Really friendly and helpful host. Lovely apartment with everything you need. Bonus cleaning everyday, as if you were in a hotel. They had left complimentary drinks for our arrival and made us feel very comfortable. They were really responsive and answered any questions we had. Everyone was so kind and friendly.

We had a good stay at Urban Quarters' apartment. The place was clean and check in was smooth. Location was great as we were walking distance to many attractions however this apartment is directly beside a mosque so night time prayer calls were quite loud if you left the windows open.

description:
The apartment is located in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport, in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I offer you a space where you can stay and feel like you are at home

reviews.text:
The apartment is conveniently close to main attractions (25 minutes walking or 15 using the tram). The zone is pretty silent at night. Sufficient space for a comfortable stay for a couple. Listed amenities were included. The host conveniently help us arrange pickup from the airport and was responsive all the time. He was kind to let us early check in.
Some considerations: No kitchen essentials were included (oil, salt, water, tea) nor for laundry. Towels and linen were smelly. The apartment is in a second floor (no elevator) and with very narrow and vertical stairs. The whole apartment is crooked so it can feel awkward at first.
Good option given the price, privacy and location.

We had a pleasant stay at Hasret's place， the size feels alright for two of us, I can't comment on the kitchen as we didn't use it， the bed is comfortable, although it sometimes squeaked, but that didn't affect our sleep. The bathroom is quite clean, shampoo and shower gel are provided which is great.
Neighbourhood might feel a little rough at the beginning if you are a solo traveler, but we soon realised it wasn't the people, it was the adjoining shacks make that rough feel.
Location wise it is great, easily get to T1 which is the one get to most of the tourist attractions.
Overall I would give our stay a 5 star for the quick response from the host, cleaness of the place, it's location and reasonably priced.

Harset was the perfect host and responded very quickly to any questions. The apartment is nicer than it looks in the pictures and was really clean and comfortable. I liked the location a lot too. It was a few minutes walk to bustling areas, but the apartment itself is on a nice quiet street. I’d recommend this place.

It was a wonderful vacation with kids in Istanbul. Location is the most convenient, very close to Galata tower, Istiklal Street, Galata Port. The host was fantastic supportive, she helped me in even small difficulties (for example to find me the nearest good hamam). She speaks English fluently, no problem with communication.Apartment was clean, with new furniture, nice bedding and AC . There were 2 rooms, enough for family 2 teenagers and 2 adults. I really satisfied, thanks!

Host was super helpful and responsive- we realised the fridge wasnt working and they managed to get a replacement sorted for the next day (on a Sunday!).
The apartment had everything we needed- it's in a great location on a quiet residential street very near to lots of cafés and ten minutes walk to a tram stop. Some reviews said the street didn't seem safe but it was absolutely fine, just steep! There's a wonderful cake shop at the bottom of the hill.
The only small issue we had was that a couple of things were missed when the place was cleaned- nothing bad enough that I felt the need to complain though.
Overall, the place was comfortable and well located for exploring Istanbul. We enjoyed our stay at Henna Apart.

description:
It is at a vibrant neighborhood nestled in the heart of Istanbul. Here are some fantastic attractions and must-visit spots within walking distance or a short commute from your Airbnb:

1. Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya)

2. Sultanahmet Square:(Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern)

3. Topkapi Palace

4. Grand Bazaar (Kapalı Çarşı)

5. Spice Bazaar (Mısır Çarşısı)
Seaside is also at walking distance, it is a good spot to RUN or walking.

reviews.text:
As others say, the place is as shown in the photos - very new, and finished to a very high standard. Similar to a very compact 4* hotel room. Some water, coffee and tea were provided plus shower gel and shampoo. The place is extremely clean. Although the surrounding streets aren't very nice, it is a short walk to decent restaurants.
Murat didn't reply to all my messages but shortly after arrival he replied promptly and I gained access. The location shown on Google Maps is wrong and I had to ask locals for directions. The housekeeper chain smokes outside with the door open, making the stairways stink of smoke. Sound insulation could be better, especially with an extremely loud and antisocial arrival at 01:30. The bed was also hard which further decreased the quality of my sleep.
If you do stay here I'd suggest a higher floor to avoid passing noise. I think overall it is good value and nicely done.

The room was very nice, clean, and comfortable, and the location was convenient. The owner was a really kind, respectful, and helpful person, which made the stay pleasant and easy. Communication was also good, and I appreciated the warm and respectful attitude throughout my stay.
One thing to note is that there was no kitchen or washing machine, which I had expected to have since this was an Airbnb. However, overall, I had a pleasant stay and especially appreciated the owner’s kindness and hospitality. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a simple and comfortable stay with a friendly and respectful host.

The accommodation was wonderful, even better than it looks in the photos. They have thought of everything, you won’t miss a thing. The cleanliness is incredible, of European standards. The owners are very friendly and ready to help you with anything you need. The location is excellent for visiting the old town. And something very important, you can find parking if you have a car. We highly recommend it.

The apartment is clean and well maintained but is very compact and small. However it was adequate for our short break.
On arrival we noticed the safe wasn't working. Someone was sent right away but said it would be fixed the next day, Saturday. On Saturday I was told no one would be available until Monday because it was weekend. Monday and Tuesday came and no one turned up. Wednesday we flew home. There was security cameras on the premises but there's a reason safes are installed in properties.
This meant we were forced to keep our cash and passports with us at all times which was not ideal.
The downside of our visit was the location which was dirty and covered with litter. Photos are available to back this up, it was pretty awful.
The flat looked just as the photos. Easy walks to many of Istanbuls tourist areas and the metro. Host was quite responsive and staff was prompt to assist.

description:
The home is located in the heart of Istanbul, just a few steps from the famous Istiklal Street and you can see the Galata Tower from window

Thanks to location, you can walk to many of Istanbul’s most iconic places, including Karaköy, Eminönü, Golden Horn, Blue Mosque and many other historical sights. You won’t need a taxi to explore the main attractions of Istanbul many of them are within walking distance from the house. You can see the Galata Tower from the window in the living room.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very light and cozy, the kitchen is clean and has all necessary appliances. The apartment has a relaxing vibe, which is helpful after long walks. There is no noise at nights.
The location of the apartment is quiet convenient, metro and bus stop is nearby, so it is easy to get to any location within Istanbul by public transport up to late night. Even though Galata is 5 minutes away, the apartment is in less noisy neighborhood. Also, the Golden Horn is a 10-minute walk away.
For the proposed price you will receive relevant quality.
The owner of apartment is very helpful.
This is my first trip and my English is not very good, and Cihan helped me a lot in a big city with a lot of tourists.
Cihan is not only the owner of the apartment, but also a really supportive person and friend. Such people are rare these days. Thank you, my Dear friend, I wish you all the best!.
I recommend this apartment. On my next trip, I will definitely stay in this apartment.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment is in a great location, just steps away from Galata Tower and within walking distance of many of Istanbul’s main attractions. There are plenty of good food spots and activities nearby, making it easy to enjoy the city without needing much transport. The neighborhood is lively but not too noisy with the right balance.
The apartment itself is exactly as shown in the photos: clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. It’s a great choice for couples looking to explore the city. Cihan was a wonderful host: very responsive, helpful, and quick to assist with anything we needed.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul, we would definitely stay again!

We loved our stay here! The apartment is in an incredible location; right in the historic heart of Istanbul and within easy walking distance to many major attractions, shops, and restaurants. The host, Cihan, was fantastic; very responsive, helpful, and reliable. There were a few small hiccups during our stay, but he handled everything quickly and made sure we were comfortable. He even kindly accommodated us with a late checkout, which we really appreciated.
Just a heads-up for future guests: the building is historic, so there’s no elevator and the stairs are quite narrow. Just to be aware in case you have large and heavy luggage. The bathroom is also on the smaller side, which might be something to note if you’re a larger person. Overall, it’s a very charming place with an outstanding host!

I had such a wonderful stay and truly couldn’t have asked for a better host. From the moment I booked the reservation, Cihan was communicating with me immediately and offering advice about transportation, currency etc. . Upon arrival, he went above and beyond by personally greeting me, helping me settle in, and providing helpful guidance throughout my stay.
The apartment was perfect, exactly as described, also had great AC and laundry setup, and everything I needed to feel comfortable. The location was also unbeatable and made exploring the the main tourist attractions so easy.
Cihan’s kindness and hospitality truly made the experience special. I’m very grateful for everything and would happily stay here again..

If you want to be near Galata, this is a great apartment! We were surprised how busy this area was, but it is a good central home base to explore the rest of Istanbul. Cihan is very nice and helpful with local recommendations. The place was clean and it was really nice to have the kitchen since restaurants around here are expensive.

description: Don't compromise your elegance while spreading out and relaxing in this flashy place. A great modern suite for 4 in a central location

reviews.text: Swanshotel was really good. A responsive host and good location, walkable distance to all the big landmarks of Sultanahmet but make sure youve got some good walking shoes as the hills are a challenge. Overall brilliant and would come back again.

We came with a baby and the family were incredibly helpful with our luggage, the baby and our needs. We stayed for five nights and we had the most beautiful views of the sea and the mosque we could hear the azaan from four different mosques at the same time. We had the best experience with the hosts and will like to come again. Best wishes to this family inshallah May you have a lot of success with this hotel. It is a new hotel only opened a month ago but it is running very well and the location is walkable to tram line and tourist sites

Great location, and solid hotel. Desk staff were helpful with things like airport transfers.
There was an issue with the Airbnb listing not aligning with their internal system, but the host resolved it :)

The accommodation’s location is very good. The Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi and the grand bazaar are just 10-15 minutes walking distances. Shops and restaurants are also close to the place (hilly place). Rooms are comfortable as well as the beds are. Kadir is kind and helps if you need. We were in one of the top rooms (5th floor) and there was a nice view to the Blue Mosque (especially the evening like a tale building). Five days were spent there and the last evening we received a fruit plate. It was really a surprise, thank you very much for that, Kadir!

We arrived in the middle of the night. The receptionist took us to a room with 2 beds in it.I showed him the text conversation where Kadir confirmed we were going to receive 2 SEPARATE bedrooms not 1 room with 2 bed. Unfortunately his English was very poor so he called Kadir who told me on the phone we can leave (in the middle of the night) or take the room.The receptionist grabbed our bad and started to walk out.I nearly ended up crying. My brother and his wife were with me and truly shocked the way we were treated.Never had this experience and I've been usin Airbnb for ages. It was SHOCKING! Then Kadir told us in two days he can get the 2 separate bedrooms but right now he has no availability. As it was in the middle of the night in true disappointment we took the room.Next morning I showed the text conversation to Kadir where he confirmed we were going to get2separate bedrooms and he said he can give it to us onlyin2 days.
From that point his attitude towards us has changed positive

description:
★ Airport Transfer / Safe and quality service
(Please get a quote.)
★ Central Location
★ Spacious Flat
★ Excellent air condition system (have 3 A/C)
★ 3rd Floor (have lift)
★ Luxury Decorated
★ Fully Equipped Kitchen
★ Clean and Modern Bathroom

One of the most beautiful locations in Istanbul. This apartment is only 8 minutes walk from the metro station and right next to Nişantaşı which is luxury shopping location in the city.

reviews.text:
Great stay at Abdullah’s place. The location is lovely and the host was super responsive from start to finish. He kindly allowed us to stay with our cats, even though the listing says no pets.
The apartment was clean, spacious, and matched the photos. Air con worked well in all main rooms, and the Wi-Fi was stable around 70 Mbps. Kitchen had the basics (no microwave) and bottled water was provided. Washer worked fine with a small drying rack.
Bedrooms were comfortable sizes, though the bed wasn’t great. We had sore backs during our stay. Minor issues like the kitchen door not closing properly and intermittent hot water, but Abdullah offered to fix it immediately.
Some light noise from the courtyard and hallway, but nothing major. Great local restaurants and taxis to the door. Parking is tricky, so be ready to unload fast.
Overall, a bright and well-equipped place with a helpful host. Would recommend.

The apartment is very good overall. It offers great value for the price, and the apartment looks exactly like in the photos (which is a very rare occasion). It has a very spacious layout, a dishwasher, a washing machine, and a vacuum cleaner, all of which were really convenient. The apartment is also clean, well-located, and well-equipped, with good water pressure, and a TV for a comfortable stay. But there are a few missing essentials: there were no dishwasher tablets, trash bags, or laundry capsules, and the amount of dishes provided was a bit limited (for maximum of 7 people). Despite these small downsides, the place was a great choice, and I would recommend it.

Family of 5, 3 rooms, 1 double size bed in main room with aircon , 2 single bed in 1 room with aircon and another 1 single bed in 1 room no aircon but not an issue, plus 2 long sofa in living room with aircon. The place is big, full kitchen and hot and cold water, towels, soap and shampoo with washing machine in the bathroom. elevator going to 3rd floor. Experience was relaxing and chill vibe. We love the place, near to bus stops in main road and walking distance in metro subway osmanbey station. All decribe in photo is accurate. Address in google maps is easy to find. Great experience and woth the stay
stay

I had a great stay at this place. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Whenever I needed anything, the host responded very quickly and was always helpful. The location was also convenient and safe. Overall, I’m very satisfied and would definitely stay here again. Thank you!
The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos. The location was great and the host was very kind and helpful. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back.

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text: Erol Bey çok yardımcı oldu, aynı gün rezervasyon yapmama rağmen odam temizlenmiş ve ben gelmeden her şey hazırlanmıştı. Resepsiyon güleryüzlü bir şekilde karşıladı beni. Temizdi, evimde gibi hissettim. Ataşehirde tekrar işlerim olursa yine burayı tercih edeceğim. Gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz.
Güzel bir konaklamaydı. temiz ve rahattı. Her şey iyiydi. Tavsiye ederim.

Erol bey çok kibar çok anlayışlıydı erkek arkadaşımın doğum günüydü tuttuğum odadan farklı bir oda sundu bize jest olarak odalar tertemizdi gönül rahatlığıyla gelebilirsiniz kendinizi evinizde hissetmek istiyorsanız 😊🙏🏻
Great and nice place. Breakfast can be ordered right to your suit at extra reasonable price
Gayet güzel bir konum

description: Welcome to your home away from home in the heart of Istanbul! Our modern and cozy apartment offers breathtaking views of the Golden Horn. From sunrise to sunset, you can fully enjoy the historic and natural beauty of Istanbul right from our large windows. In the evening, the city lights reflecting on the Golden Horn create a peaceful and enchanting atmosphere.

reviews.text:
The apartment was exactly like the photos - spotless, cozy, and perfectly equipped! The internet was super fast, the TV was large and great, and the sofa and bed were very comfortable.
There was everything you could possibly need: dining table, bathroom essentials, kitchen utensils (even more than at home!), microwave, vacuum cleaner, iron and ironing board, and several towels.
The location was amazing — a bakery and lovely cafés right downstairs, a grocery store just two minutes away, and a bus stop in front of the house that takes you directly to Taksim in 15-20 minutes.
Everything was simply perfect. Thank you so much
-we'll definitely come back!

First of all the place was approachable from the airport, easy to find and great location with beautiful sea view.
The bus station is right on the door, and the ships station 5 mins walk away.
The place is very clean and provided with the listed amenities and all of them are high quality.
The place is so clean, and you have extra bed sheets so you can easily change them by yourself.
The host is very responsive and always connected to solve any possible issues.
Very happy to choose this place and definitely coming next years 😍 this was the most beautiful visit to Istanbul.

The communication was great. The room was as pictured. Very close to bus stops and ferry terminals. A101 small supermarket very close for basic neededs. Bed was super comfy! A very very good location for exploring Istanbul. Would recommend and will definitely stay again!!!

The apartment is well connected to public transport, bus stop right in front of the building. It is a modern apartment, well insulated and quiet. The owners are very responsive. There are three locked doors before you get in the apartment, and cameras on the staircase, we felt very safe. A supermarket is 5 min walking distance. There are bakeries, ATM's and coffee shops around. We spent 6 weeks here and we will stay here again.
The location is great, near to Balat and Taksim area. The view is amazing. Everything is well thought. The apartment is very stylish and comfortable.

description:
We are Mayer Property Mngmt company with over 90 apts in our portfolio. Our 2Br apt in the city center is located in a newly built Skycon residence Fulya/Besiktas and has easy access to all attractions, hip restaurants & cafes in its neighborhood. The apt is 90 sqm and well designed for our guest's needs: 2 bedrooms, kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a large living room w/ Balcony, and a bathroom with a hairdryer and washing machine.
We look forward to hosting you here.

reviews.text:
House was new which was a big plus. Most kitchen utensils weren’t used. Utensils aren’t enough if you are planing on cooking.
The house is located down on a hill so be prepared to walk if you don’t have a private car.
The shower head was broken and I reported it but nothing was done during our 12 day stay. The photos were deceiving as the apartment looked much bigger.

I've stayed in this apartment in Istanbul for 12 days — very satisfied.
Clean, cozy, and well-maintained. Everything needed for a comfortable stay was available. Convenient location, smooth check-in and communication.
Would recommend.

We were visiting during the Eid Al-Adha break so it was especially quiet which was really lovely. The apartment is in a nice modern building that is centrally located (main area’s can be like 10 mins away), it’s spacious, free of clutter & has the listed amenities available.
The team allowed me to check in early (I had messed up my arrival date so had actually arrived a day earlier, spent the night in a hotel & was able to access the apartment from the morning already) which I feel was very kind.
The remote for the aircon wasn’t working properly upon arrival & the team sent over new batteries very quickly.
I would absolutely consider staying here again for future trips to Istanbul.

Çok kötüydü, ev göründüğü gibi değildi kirli kırık dökük ve bozuk eşyalar, heryeri pislik içinde, konumu berbat heryere ulaşım sıkıntı, ful yokuş , taksiciler o sokağa girmek istemiyor, heryer yokuş, çok pahalı, en önemlisi güvenli değildi, geceleri kaldığımız yerdeki yan dairedeki seks partilerinin gürültüsündenn, ve bunlar gurup şeklinde yapılıyor, çoluk çocuk maf olduk, Aile ortamı diye gittik . Malesef çok kötü bir yere düştük verdiğim paraya değmezmiş, ulaşıma harcadığımız parada cabası, evde böcekten geçilmiyor kafamı böcek soktu hastaneye gittim, fotoğraf larda göründüğü gibi değil. Herşey eski ve kirli.

The apartment is great. The host is very responsiveness and always met me halfway even in small inconveniences. We asked for a better cleaning and the next day they organized one more general cleaning. The host always responded really fast to all my messages. The apartment is big, spacious and very bright. And the terrace stole my heart. I would stay there again!

description: Easily access local hot spots from this hip place. Only 20 meters from famous istiklal street. Our hotel is located in the heart of Taksim/Beyoglu. Only 1-minute walking distance to the famous Istiklal Street. This room has 1 double (queen) bed and a private bathroom. 7/24 open reception you can check in anytime, checkout time is 12:00.

reviews.text: First, the host responded to my messages right away in a friendly manner. The location is in an excelent place. Close to all kinds of transportation, places to eat, walkable stores beautiful sites. Now, because this is a place with night life you maight think twice about the noise level. It did not bother me at all. I had my ear plugs. The room and bathroom were neat and clean. Air conditioned, W F conection worked perfectly. Front desk people were very amicable and helpful . Love the hotel.

Taksim tarafında kalınabilecek en iyi yer olduğunu gönül rahatlığıyla söyleyebilirim. Girişimiz çok rahattı ve giriş saatinde esneklik sağladılar. Oda, banyo, yatak tertemizdi ve TV çalışıyordu (taksimdeki diğer airbnd'lerde henüz çalıştığını görmedim o yüzden özellikle belirtiyorum). Personel güleryüzlü ve her konuda yardıma hazırlardı. Samimi ve güvende hissettiğimiz bir yerdi. Hotelin konumu da harika. Taksim meydanı ve istiklal caddesine bir sokak uzakta. Yemek yiyebileceğiniz, gezebileceğin her yere çok yakın. Kesinlikle öneriyorum, rahatlıkla 5 yıldız veriyorum.

A truly wonderful and clean place, with an excellent location close to everything, especially Taksim Square and Istiklal Street.
Special thanks to Mr. Saeed for his kindness and helpfulness, and the staff were friendly and cooperative. A great experience that I highly recommend.

Gerçekten temiz, rahat ve güvende hissettiğimiz bir yer. Personeli güleryüzlü ve her zaman her konuda yardımcı olmaya hazır. Burası hakkında olumsuz anlamda söyleyebileceğim hiçbir şey yok. Üstelik gezilebilecek her yere yakın. Taksim meydanı ve istiklalle aranızda 30 metre var. Taksimde kalabileceğiniz en güzel yerlerden biri. Gönül rahatlığıyla önerebilirim.

We stayed for two nights, mainly to have a place to sleep and to spend the days and nights outside. For this, the room was perfect - small but clean and equipped with everything you'd need for an overnight stay. Location is top, would recommend if you are searching for a great value for money accomodation.

description:
We have no Elevator in the Building !!! Just for your information
''Pashas House'' is in the heart of the historical peninsula near everything! Just a 10 minute walk from Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace......
''Pashas House''is Fully Furnished, Fridge, Small Kitchen and Washing Machine, and a small Dining Corner
It is very easy to find Markets, Restaurants, Bakery and Tobacco Shops around.
''Pashas House''try to make your stay more comfortable then a 5 Star Hotel.

reviews.text:
I stayed with a party of 6 in this apartment, it was great and the host was even greater. The apartment is just like in the pictures (or even nicer), it is beautifully decorated, clean and FULLY equipped. The beads are really comfortable, and everything worked perfectly. On top of this our refrigerator was filled with bottled water and soda, we had coffee machines and ground coffee beans (Turkish and drip), sugar, salt, pepper,oil, etc; we had soap and shampoo in the bathroom, all included. Barbaros is an amazing host that waited us with (courtesy) breakfast when we arrived at 4:30 am after our plane got really delayed. This tells a lot about the person, one week before we were charged 30 euros for arriving half an hour late to pickup the keys for an apartment in Paris; but this guy waits for us 5 extra hours and gets us breakfast!!!!!! Aside from this he was very kind to give us some guidance, he called to check that everything was OK and came to help with the washing machine (it's in Turkish so I didn't get how to use it).
The location of the apartment is good, you're at walking distance from almost all tourist attractions in Istanbul; there is also a supermarket, pharmacy and other shops around. Four blocks away there are some nice restaurants that are a must.... Barbaros has a restaurant there which is very nice and food is delicious (I had the best fish ever), he sat down with us and shared a bit of Turkish culture, politics and religion, we had a great evening there. The nearest bus stop is 6 blocks away and tram is around 8 blocks away. We used mostly taxis which are cheap and you can just take them in front of the apartment. I would compare this with a 4 stars hotel for the quality of the place and the service but it has more to it, it feels a bit like home or staying at a friends house.

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It looks just like the pictures. Very clean and spacious, but note the kitchen is fairly small. It does however have everything you could need. They also had quite a few toys that my son played with...a nice surprise . Also they have air con and wifi - a major plus!
We didn't meet Barbaros but we met Ali. He was the most friendliest and helpful host ever!! We arrived by our taxi and the taxi driver was charging us extra but Ali came to our rescue! He is very very nice and was available 24 hrs!
Location is decent, about 10 to 15 min walk from all the sites, but note many streets are uphill, so it may feel a bit longer (esp in the heat).
The only problem with the apartment is the noise level from the street at night. Also the first day there was some water problem and we had no water at all for showers etc! But luckily that got fixed the next day.
A tip: taxi from the airport is about 45 liras which is much cheaper than the airport shuttle service.

I review in my own standard manner:
1. Is it safe? Apartment is in an area that is scruffy and down at heel. We walked around at night and the area felt ok. The door to the building is locked and you access with electronic key. The apartment has a double lock. So overall we felt acceptably safe.
2. Host . Ali was host for us. Excellent fellow, he met us and explained apartment and even gave us an Istanbulkart before we could get our own. He arranged transfers to and from airport for us. We were very happy with Ali.
3. Location. It’s 15 minute walk to the hippodrome so it’s position is excellent. Similarly 10 minutes to grand bazaar. Supermarket is only 100 metres. It’s not well located for metro or trams yes it’s close but up steep hills so easy if walking but not if with luggage.
4. Facilities. Everything in the listing was in the apartment.
It was cold while we were in Istanbul. Apartment was nice and warm . Two large radiators supply enough heat. We could see no method of controlling them from apartment except on or off. So we left them on and that kept place at a comfortable ?22degrees?
Kitchen has everything but limited space. So we found perfect for breakfast and a lunch but would have been cramped if we had tried to prepare dinner.
Shower hot. Everything worked.
The floor/ceiling above is thin so you can hear people above as they walk around. But they seemed conscious of it and were respectful.
5. Cleanliness? It was spotless perfect.
6. Value? Good value
Recommend? Yes we do recommend as a great location for discovering (on foot) the major sites of Istanbul.
We really enjoyed hearing the call to prayer each morning. Yes it woke us up but in a very pleasant manner. It felt terrifically authentic and caused us to appreciate where we were.

Ali was there and waiting for us when we arrived and he was an obliging and considerate host. He even got up early morning - we left at the crack of dawn - to see us off.
The apartment is well-situated, especially if you're looking to stay in Sultanahmet, since it's within walking distance to all the sites (about a 10-minute walk) but still removed from the touristy hustle and bustle (which can get crazy this time of year).
The neighborhood is full of restaurants, dessert shops (even a 24-hour one!) and lovely cats :)
The apartment had everything we needed and is well-organized, clean, and cozy. The beds - even the sofa bed - were comfortable. There's a small kitchen and a fridge, and 'though the settings are a bit too small to cook in, it's more than enough for quick snacks and beverages - there's even a Turkish coffee maker provided. Plus, there are more than enough restaurants around.
The only drawback to our stay was that the ceiling was thin and we could hear everything that was said/done upstairs, which might not be a problem if there are no guests staying upstairs, but could be a bit rough when there are (we eventually had to go upstairs and ask the guests to keep it down after midnight).
Overall, the host is always on-site, the location is good, and the apartment clean and cozy. It was a good stay :)

the apartment is exactly as per the pictures, nice clean and peaceful place it has all the necessary stuff and very well maintained , 24hrs Hot water, Wifi, central heater, AC, original style and decoration.
Host (Mr Barbaros) was very nice, friendly, very helpful and always listening to our request.
we didn't felt left at any moment, really thanks to him.
the location is perfect, near to most popular places and landmark in walkable distance.
around 10 Min you will reach :
Sultanahmet (blue Mosque)
AyaSofia
Beyazit Mosque
grand Bazar
10-15min
TopKapi palace
gulhane park
around 20-25 min you will reach
Suleymaniye Mosque & Mausoleum of Suleyman the magnificent (Suleyman Qanuni) which will give you splendid view about the golden horn of Bosphorus.
if you don’t want to walk and you prefer transportation, the apartment is :
10 Min from Beyazit T1 Tram & station BN1 Bus station
20 Min from Yenikapi ,this is hub station, Metro Green & red line in addition to Marmaray train.

description: Situated in the heart of Moda, my flat is just steps away from trendy cafes, shops, supermarkets, transportation options, and cultural spots. The flat is stylishly decorated with a blend of modern and cosy elements, ensuring a comfortable atmosphere. You can enjoy the spacious rooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private balcony. You can immerse yourself in Istanbul’s dynamic culture while having a tranquil retreat to return to. As a local Moda resident, I’m available to help when you need.

reviews.text: One of the most exceptional Airbnb stays I’ve had. The apartment is elegant, spotless, and even more beautiful than the photos. Every detail was thoughtfully considered, and the 600 Mbps WiFi and large Google TV made it both work- and entertainment-friendly. Check-in was smooth via a lockbox, and Elif was a gracious and highly responsive host. The location in Moda, Kadıköy, is fantastic—just a short stroll to popular cafes, restaurants, and the pier. A perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. I’ll definitely return if I’m ever on the Asian side of Istanbul. Highly recommended…. Thank you for hosting us, Elif. I truly appreciate all the help and support. Have a good one 👍

This is a nice place! It’s very central and we loved the area. It’s also a beautiful apartment and easy to share with 4 or more people. For everything we got, the price was very good. Elif is really nice, responses very quickly and is always helpful. If I had to say any criticism it would be the walk up the stairs (no elevator) and the temperature in the bedrooms (no ac‘s). Great trip! Great place! Great city!

Elif is a fantastic host, the attention to detail, always looking up for us. Her place is fantastic, clean, cozy, spacious, well heated, and located in the heart of Kadikoy. With a short walk you can access numerous restaurants and locations in the neighborhood, and despite this, the apartment is quite private and quiet. Finally, the attention to details in the apartment is fantastic, upon arrival we felt at home, we had all the basics to cook, we also had shampoo, conditioner, and furthermore also had usb chargers, bottled water and some small fresh water battles. We'll surely return to Istanbul, and we'll make sure to check the availability to come back here.

I've been to Istanbul many times, and this is one of the best options. The perfect area for any visitor to the city. If you love peace and nature, the beautiful Kadikoy embankment is nearby. If you're looking for a vibrant nightlife, bars and clubs are also nearby. The apartment itself feels like a home, not a commercial property. It has everything you need, and it's very cozy. Everything is clean and quiet. Comfortable beds, fast internet, and many other advantages make you feel right at home. Elif is very caring and always willing to help. If this apartment is available next time, I will choose it.

The house is very beautiful and clean, in a very nice neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars.
Air conditioning is present only in one of the 2 bedrooms.
The only small issue was that the small bedroom bed was quite uncomfortable, being too soft.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Shiva was a wonderful host – friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and check-in was smooth. I really enjoyed my stay and would gladly recommend this place to other travelers. Thank you, Shiva!

Fantastic host! Very responsive.
I truly enjoyed my time there. The location is unbeatable -but this of course comes with noise, which I would have loved to know about in advance. The window up front lets all the noise and music from the cafe through, so you never really have silence at home during the day.
There is no space/desk/table to work from. There's a table in the terrace, but it's not suitable for remote work. Very cute cats in the terrace though!
The flat could definitely use some maintenance, but makes up for it with it's location and charm. :)

I really enjoyed my stay at Mehmet's property and I tried to extend my booking by another week, but another lucky guest got in before me.
Unfortunately when I arrived though, the property was not clean (full rubbish bins including cat food pouches and cigarette butts, mouldy filter in the coffee machine, dirty towel on the bathroom floor) - but Mehmet and his team arrived quickly to resolve the issues. Mehmet and I even bumped into each other later in the week and had coffee together. It was all cool!
The location is great with lots of good cafes and bars nearby, although Mehmet's property is relatively quiet. A bonus of Mehmet's property is that there are only a few stairs to enter the property (unusual for Istanbul!). I recommend this property!
This is a great apartment! Very cozy, great location and amazing host. Had a very good stay here and it’s even better than the pictures!

Host is very kind. Easy to communicate. Answer time is very short. Suit is not big but it is nice. It has small balcony. It will fulfill your needs. I can just say bed is not comfortable, bed is so close to floor.

description: This unique place has a style all its own.

reviews.text:
Stay was great! Mehmet was superchill and welcome :)
He let us checkout a bit later and helped with checking in.
Apartment is nice and clean. Furniture is a bit old but thare is good working AC which is really helpfull during hot summer days!
Location is also amazing - close to everything in Kadiköy! Recommend a place for everyone young-fun-happy

Mehmet’s apartment is an excellent choice for anyone seeking a peaceful and comfortable stay. The space is clean, comfortable, well-kept, and offers a prime location close to local attractions and the sea. Mehmet is a gracious host, making this the perfect home base regardless of the purpose of your visit.

I spent a month in Mehmet’s apartment and loved it. It is right in the heart of bohemian Kadikõy with public transport on the doorstep and a 5 min walk to the ferry terminal and Metro. Any issues I had only came from the age of the traditional Istanbul building and were quickly handled by Mehmet.
Beds are comfortable and shower and toilet were great. Stairs are a killer but all part of the experience! I’d happily stay again. Ideal if you want to stay in the heart of Kadıköy and everything it has to offer. Not glamorous but earthy and traditional. And not set up to cater for yourself really but who has to with so many fantastic restaurants on your doorstep.
Brilliant stay all round and was very sad to leave
As an interior designer I’d have loved to get my hands on the flat to make it over but I do this in my head wherever I stay 😆

Mehmet is the best host you could ask for while staying in one of the busiest parts of Istanbul. He responds quickly, efficiently and always positive. The place was clean and everything worked just as it was supposed to work. Location of the flat is just perfect, more than we expected. Even though it is on a busier part of Kadikoy, when you are in the bedrooms it is quiet and peaceful. If I come back to Kadikoy again I will pick Mehmet’s flat.
Quiet basic interior, but clean, great shower and good lookstion near the Kadiköy harbour. Mehmet was very responsive and helpful via message. Recommended!

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet place next to the Sancak Bridge in the center of Pendik, a clean family apartment. We are within a 3-4 minute walking distance to Pendik Marmaray. You will stay in a place that will easily meet all your needs, 5 minutes by car to the istmarina, 5 minutes by car to the ferries and the marina. There is a bagel bakery, bread bakery, pastry shops, markets and Bosnian taverns right next to the house.

reviews.text: Ev fazlasıyla temiz ve tüm ihtiyaçlarınızı karşılayacak şekilde dekore edilmiş. Fotoğrafta görünenden kesinlikle fazlası mevcut. Ev sahibi aşırı ilgili, gerek rezervasyon süreci gerek evle alakalı memnuniyet için sürekli iletişim halindeydi. Tercih edilebilir.

Sabiha Gökçene erişimi sebebiyle tercih etmiştim uçuşum vardı sabahında. konumu çok idealdi. Ev temiz düzenli ve çok şıktı. çamaşır makinesinden kurutucuya kadar herşey düşünülmüştü. keyifle kaldım Alper beye teşekkür ederim İstanbul'a geldiğimde düşünmeden tekrar konaklarım

Evi çok rahat buldum. Garajı vardı, park sorunu yoktu. bi tarafı cadde üzerine bi tarafı sakin nezih bir sokağa bakıyor. Gayet düzgün güvenilir bir yerdi. Alper bey çok ilgiliydi. Her konuda yardımcı oldu. Evin içerisi tertemiz ve düzenliydi. sıcak suyu vardı. her şey anlatıldığı gibiydi.
Fotoğraflardan çok daha fazlasını sunan bir ev ve her ihtiyaç ile ilgilenen, dost canlısı bir ev sahibi. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim
Alper bey öncelikli olarak giriş saati konusunda yardımcı oldu. bu sayede erkenden giriş yaptım, ev bahsedildiği gibiydi herşey çok temiz ve düzenliydi. tekrar tercih edeceğim bir yer oldu benim için

description: Newly renovated two bedroom apartment which has unique design and promises high quality comfortable stay for long and short stays. All furnishings are tailor made to match with the quality feeling and providing comfortable stay. This unique place has a style all its own.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, spacious, and very comfortable. The location was perfect, close to everything I needed, yet quiet enough to relax. Check-in was smooth and easy, and the host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay.

The apartments are pretty clean, nicely decorated. The area is also pretty good it’s easy to get an uber to and from the apartment, it’s slightly further out so a walk to anywhere is about 20ish minutes but transport is really good from the location the tram is only down the road. Street was safe we felt all right walking home on a night and to enter the building the safety was good. No noise or anything on a night it’s a pretty chill area compared to other parts of istanbul. Beds were very clean and quite comfy. Showers great. Receptionists were helpful overall a decent place to stay.

My stay at Ando Living - Taksim Gümüşsuyu Townhouse was nothing short of exceptional! From the moment I arrived, the staff welcomed me with warmth and professionalism, ensuring every detail was perfect. The apartment itself is a stunning blend of modern elegance and cozy comfort, impeccably clean, and thoughtfully designed with stylish decor and top-notch amenities. Its prime location in the heart of Taksim made exploring Istanbul a breeze, with vibrant cafes, shops, and cultural spots just steps away. The personalized service, including prompt responses to any request, truly elevated the experience. I felt right at home and can’t wait to return! Highly recommend this gem to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Incredible, modern place outfitted with high end furnishing and very well located. The front desk made it feel like a hotel stay. I could text them for whatever needed, laundry, deliveries, etc. Uber pickups were easy. Internet was strong for web meetings. Amazing all around. Will stay here again.

The apartment was modern and clean. It has everything that makes a stay great. The location is good. It takes about 10 minutes of downhill walk to reach Kabatas station which is one of the main tram stations to get to all the historical sites.
Climbing back up at the end of the day can be painful. We discovered that there is a funicular F1 from Kabatas station that will take you to Taxim Square and then you can walk down to the apartment. Once we discovered that life became so much easier next Taxim square is a 10 minute walk away.
The location and the apartment are very good and I would recommend it for a great stay in Istanbul.

description: If you stay in this apartment, which is in a central location, you will be close to everywhere. It is within walking distance to Sultanahmet Square, Hagia Sophia, Yerebatan Cistern and historical places. It takes an average of 10 to 15 minutes.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a central location, within walking distance of shops and restaurants and entertainment spots. It was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos.
The host was responsive, helpful, and trustworthy. Communication was excellent, and check-in was easy. I accidentally left some belongings behind, but the host kept them safe for me.
Highly recommended.

We stayed as family for 10 days, great area very close to sultan ahmet camii 5 min walk, a supermarket also close, restaurant everywhere.
The flat on the second floor there is no elevator, the flat was so clean.
Mr Orhan is a good man and responsive.
Just the stairs are uncomfy.
I highly recommend this place for staying.

Our one week stay was made very enjoyable by Orhan’s proactive and responsive attitude, both for recommendations and small incidents.
The place is super well located to explore Sultanahmet area, clean and overall well equipped. Air conditioning is effective and welcome !
The neighbourhood is lively so nights can get a little noisy if you’re not used to it.

Evin konumu çok iyi , sabah namazı kılmak için 3 dakikada Sultan Ahmet camiine ulaştım. Evin bulunduğu konum itibariyle gece ses oluyor, birkaç kez yükses sesle kavga v.s sebeple uykumuzdan uyandık. Orhan bey çok güler yüzlü ve ilgili bir ev sahibi. Her türlü soruya ve soruna yardımcı olmaya çalıştı. Evde ihtiyaç duyulan çoğu şey var . Balkon olmadığı için Çamaşır kurutmak biraz sıkıntı oldu. 24 saat sıcak suya rahatla ulaşabildik. Klima gayet güzel çalışıyor ve tüm odalara yetti. Evde süpürge, şampuan, bulaşık deterjanı, çamaşır makinesi deterjanı, temizlik ürünleri mevcuttu.
Very cozy and clean apartment, right in the centre of Sultanahmed. Very close to a lot of sights. Host was very friendly and responsive. I will book again.

description:
Only 5 minutes walking distance to Galataport and 10 minutes walking distance to Galata Tower, it consists of 2 bedrooms, open kitchen and living area. Bedrooms provide privacy with curtains.
-Located on the 2nd floor of the building, no elevator, easy to access
-Fully equipped (Air conditioning, wireless internet connection, dishwasher, automatic coffee machine, hair dryer + iron, vacuum cleaner, kitchen utensils and much more)
-Paid parking is 30 meters away.

reviews.text:
The location in which the apartament is placed couldn't be better. It's above beautiful cafes and in walkable distance to T1 tram line. You can get to Sultanahmet in 15 min via tram. The district around is great and there's a superb grilled mackrel lavash wrap nearby. The tradeoff is that it's noisy until very late evening. Check in is super easy and we definately found tranquility coming back after a busy day in Istanbul streets.
The place itself seems much smaller than it looks. It's also way darker to a point you need to use lights during the daytime. The bed is extremally uncomfortable which paired with the noise resulted in very mediocre sleep. There's no table to eat at - only a small living room table. The bathroom was superficially cleaned, with noticable mold on the shower doors and ceiling. The toilet wasn't properly cleaned and some surfaces felt sticky.
Overall we liked the privacy of our stay but we felt we overpaid for the quality we recieved.

Place was clean and good location . But Not the best district it was small, very noisy since there is a bar just down the building . Appartement looks very big in photos what is the opposite it was so small . Smell in appartement was not nice . One of hosts was not helpful at all . I asked for extra checkout so i have time to pack . she give me 15min plus and sent the cleaning lady knocking the door . Would never come back and not worth the price respectfully :) . Never been disappointed on an airbnb for 10 years using it , the first time .

great place that is clean, easy to check into and comfortable to stay in. the hosts are amazing women who are extremely proactive when it comes to communicating. we received an easy-to-understand manual about checking in and using the different amenities. lovely place in a great neighbourhood.
i think this place is great for short stays of 1-3 nights, because it is a smaller space. it’s a studio apartment, where the two bedrooms are sectioned off by curtains. this makes noise and light travel, so you are constantly aware of other people’s activities in the apartment. because the apartment is small, it can also feel a bit overheated.
nevertheless, it was quite and enjoyable stay. we booked for one night, but i probably would stay for two nights next time because it is so well-located and the hosts are so great. thank you!

Daha ilk andan itibaren doğru bir seçim yaptığımızı hissettik, evin konumu gerçekten harikaydı; Karaköy ve Beyoğlu’na çok yakın, her yere kolayca ulaşabildik.
Giriş süreci oldukça pratik ve sorunsuzdu. Evin çevresinde market ve ihtiyaçlara erişim de çok rahattı.
Ev oldukça temizdi ve fotoğraflarda görünenin birebir aynısıydı. İhtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey eksiksiz düşünülmüştü. Ev sahipleri son derece cana yakın ve ilgiliydi, konaklama boyunca iletişim halindeydiler.
Ayrıca dışarıdan gelen sesler hiç rahatsız etmedi. Genel olarak çok memnun kaldık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb in Karaköy. The location is truly fantastic. right in the heart of the action in istanbul, with plenty of restaurants, cafes, and Galataport just steps away. It’s also a short, 13min walk to Galata Tower, and the tramway is conveniently nearby, making it easy to explore the rest of Istanbul.
The apartment itself was clean and comfortable, but we encountered one small issue: the TV was disconnected from the internet, so we couldn’t use it during our stay. Other than that, everything else was smooth, and I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a convenient base in Karaköy.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit. My apartment is within walking distance of Süleymaniye Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Aksaray Square, Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia and many historical areas. There are many bus lines close to my house. Also, the subway is a 5-minute walk and the tram is an 8-minute walk.

reviews.text: Everything was great Tahir was super fast at responding, kind and courteous . His friend let us in and was very helpful getting me a clothes airer and coat hangers she was also extremely polite and a kind soul. The apartment is exactly as described and was spotlessly clean water pressure I've never known so strong so a power shower it certainly is 😀. Beds are comfortable linen fresh smelling. Shops for essentials on doorstep as are few cafes Ubers up to the golden horn are around £5, lots of other public transport available within 4ins walk and 25 mins walk gets you everywhere of historical interest. No traffic noise as double glazing is great. I've no complaints at all. Just one note there are 3 flights of stairs so wouldn't be suitable for persons with mobility issues. I will be happy to make this my home from home in Istanbul, thank you Tahir and also to your friend too. See you again very soon.

A nice place to stay at a good price compared to other options in the area.
The apartment was clean and comfortable overall. However, there were two downsides: it’s located on the third floor with scary stairs, and the internet connection was most of the time unreliable.

The host is super friendly.
The apartment is 0.8 miles away from Hagia Sophia and ferry terminals. Walkable streets nearby.
There is a parking and it charges 250 lira a day.
Street parking can be hard to find even at night.
It’s a small apartment the sofa bed is not up to standard a bit shaky.
The fridge should be looked at it’s not working properly.

Friendly and responsive owner. Good value for money. Unfortunately, for us this place wasn’t cozy as the apartment looks old and requires some renovation. The bed sheets and towels were also very old and had stains.
Everything was wonderful! The house was very clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Tahir was a great and responsive host. Highly recommended!

description: Located in the center of Kadıköy, this apartment is ideally located for your trip to Istanbul. You can reach all the amenities of Kadıköy (Cafes, Bars, Bazaar) on foot, as well as all means of transportation that will allow you to travel in Istanbul. Moreover, on a street with historical Yeldeğirmeni houses, we have a cute and peaceful garden that will take you away from city life :)

reviews.text: Öncelikle konum gayet merkezi bir yerdeydi. Mekan fotoğraflardakiyle birebir aynıydı. Gayet kolaylıkla bulunabilecek bir daireydi. Gülay hanım gayet hızlı iletişime geçti çok kibardı ve fazlasıyla yardımcı oldu. Ev hijyen olarak gayet temizdi ve düzenliydi, sadece tek bir sorun vardı ev yeni boya yapılmış büyük ihtimalle ve güzel havalandırılmamıştı o yüzden boya kokusu biraz rahatsız etti ama havalandırdıktan sonra o sorun da çözüldü :) Hava şartları nedeniyle bahçeyi kullanmamak içimizde kalsa da hava güzel olduğu zaman bahçeyi kullanmak için yine uğrayacağımız bir yer olacaktır gibi gözüküyor. Gülay Hanım'a her şey için teşekkür ediyoruz.

Hijyen acısından baya kötüydü fotoğraf ekleyeceğim konum olarak gayet iyidi ama fotoğraflardaki gibi değildi ev çok bakımsızdı biz eve gidiğimizde temizlenmemişti ev sahibi anlayışlıydı ama mağdur edildik gecenin göründe kalacak yer bulmakta hayli zor oluyor

This was a great location, close to main area with pubs and shops. Also very close to the ferry. Walkable distance.
The small garden was a big plus, especially for this price and the location.
Good communication with Gülay.
Easy to check-in.

My partner and I had a wonderful few days staying in Gulay's flat in Kadikoy. The flat suited our needs perfectly and Gulay was very flexible to them. Gulay was a responsive and clear communicator.
The flat is comfortable and has good outdoor space. It is very well located only a 5 minute walk to the ferry terminal.
It is a bohemian neighbourhood with lots of beautiful design shops and coffee shops to sit in. Also if you like climbing there is a bouldering centre a 2 minute walk away.
Highly recommend staying in one of Gulay's flats.
Great place to stay, one can reach with foot many visiting place, it is nearby good food spots. Clean and beautiful. The owners are great, helpful and very friendly people 💯💯💯

description:
4 people can easily stay
In the hotel concept, at home temperature
two rooms with two double beds for 4 people
a private kitchen
private bathroom
private toilet
a peaceful apartment.

You will be in a very nice location in the center of the city, within walking distance to historical places, surrounded by nice restaurants.
We believe you'll have a peaceful vacation when you're a guest.

We are waiting for you.

reviews.text:
Place worths the price you pay for. It's close by walking to main tourist attractions (blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, basilic cistern, Topkapi palace,...), there are many restaurant options around and their prices are cheaper compared to others.
Beds were comfortable and clean, bathroom also clean. Host is super friendly and ready to help! I definitely recommend it as a low cost hostel.

A truly great place to stay. Comfortable beds, clean apartment and amazing location. Walkable distance from busy areas and public transportation. The area itself has a lot to offer - supermarkets, shops, restaurants (we especially liked the one that's really close to the apartment - a little bit down the stairs) and more. Melike is an amazing host, responsive and helpful whenever we've had questions! Overall great experience! I recommend!

The host Melike was quite responsive to all my messages, she kindly agreed to let us keep our bags at a safe space as we arrived early. The place was clean.
The Airbnb has 2 rooms but just 1 AC which was not working. On informing it to Ms. Gul (caretaker) she insisted that there was no issue with the AC. After sending several messages to Melike and also escalating it to Airbnb customer support the AC was fixed in the night.
Other issues I found were that Ms. Gul would just open the door and let herself in when we were in the Airbnb or when we were out. The toilet seat was broken, had to shower in cold water on some days, some of the amenities listed were missing.
Some of the tourist attractions are 20 minutes walk but we had to take a taxi to visit other areas as the nearest bus stop is 30 minutes away.
Overall, it was a hectic stay where lot of time and energy was spent in solving issues.

The place is centrally located, and Melike is very responsive. She has another host managing the property who doesn’t speak English. The rooms are great for the price. The only slight issue was on the first night—just 10 minutes after check-in, the host asked us to keep our voices down as the noise carries upstairs. We were only chatting casually, but due to the door’s transparency and the staircase amplifying sound, it echoed through the house. In an Airbnb, we should at least have the freedom to talk or chat—playing music or singing might be an issue, which I understand, but simply chatting? That shouldn’t be a problem. However, there were no further issues after that. Overall, the place is worth it!

Had a lovely couple of nights at Melikes place. It was clean and the location was excellent! Ms Gul was helpful getting us settled even though we spoke no Turkish and the place had working wifi and comfortable beds. Thank you both!

Me and my daughter really enjoyed this place. Bruno’s hospitality was especially wonderful - he made us feel very welcome. The location is perfect: all the main attractions are within walking distance, and there are plenty of restaurants around for every taste. In the evenings, after exploring the city, we loved hanging out on the hotel rooftop while Bruno played great music. The room had air conditioning, so we slept very well, and it was equipped with everything we needed. Highly recommended!
We only stayed for a night during a long layover, but it was a lovely stay — comfortable, clean, great location, and we appreciated the personal recommendations and communication. Highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay here. It was a small, cozy room, perfect for two people, and within walking distance of the sea and many historical sites.
I would just suggest having a few more essentials in the kitchen, such as towels, salt, and oil. These little things can be very helpful if they’re available.
I needed to work during my stay, but the internet wasn’t stable enough for me to connect through VPN, so I had to buy a data SIM from Türk Telekom. If you don’t need to work, the internet should be good enough, although it does disconnect quite often.

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Bruno's place. The apartment was clean and just what we needed for a temporary homebase while staying in Istanbul. We enjoyed the location, which was easy to walk around to the local sites and had a variety of great restaurants close by. Bruno was an excellent host and we enjoyed our time hanging out together on the roof deck chatting and enjoying turkish coffee. 10/10 would recommend this place for your visit to Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The location of the apartment was excellent and very convenient for exploring Istanbul. The flat looked exactly like the photos, and both check-in and check-out were easy and smooth. Overall, the apartment was clean and comfortable.
There were a few minor issues during our stay. The air conditioning did not work very well, and because there were no mosquito screens on the windows, we could not leave them open without getting many mosquitoes inside. Also, the TV was mainly decorative, as it was neither a smart TV nor connected to any TV channels.
Despite these small issues, we had a pleasant stay overall.

The place looks the same as the photos. The sofa was not so soft but it was fine. They forgot the cover for the sofa but the host was very responsive and delivered it immediately when we asked. The host replies very fast. The place is very clean and smells good. The Galata tower was very near, you can reach it by feet within a few mins. Going to Eminonu was easy from the place its only 15-20 mins walk or around 8mins to get to the cruise station. We check in as a family with a baby and we never had a problem (we apologise if there are some biscuits/food on the floor because of the baby, if theres a broom we would have cleaned it). Our only concern is there is no basic condiments or seasoning like salt, sugar and pepper. Also please leave a broom inside, thanks. Overall our experience with the place and host was satisfactory, we are very pleased. Thank you, Nazifcan 😊.

The host was not communicative and did not provide basic check-in details such as room number, floor, and Wi-Fi information (prior to check-in). I had to repeatedly ask for information and items throughout the stay.
The room was not so clean. There was visible dirt and dust on the floor, and the cooking hob were oily.
Many items were broken/damaged, indicating poor maintenance. The most unacceptable issue was the broken bidet valve, which is a basic facility. Although it was fixed the next day after I demanded a repair, this should never have happened.
The situation worsened when the air conditioner remote was taken without notice, claiming the general heater was on. The room became hot and uncomfortable, forcing me to open the window fully. Air conditioning is listed as an amenity, yet guests were denied control.
Despite all these issues, the host never apologized. Due to poor communication, cleanliness, misleading amenities, and lack of maintenance, I do not recommend this place.

This place is in need of maintenance and love, it's falling apart. It also was dirty when we arrived with hair in the bathroom, scummy dishes in the cupboard, and dust/dirt everywhere. no cleaning products were provided either, so we couldn't clean the place, this includes dish soap and sponges. We also only got one body towel and one hand towel for the entire apartment for 2 people over 5 nights, which sucked. There is a washing machine that works, but no rack for drying. The hot water heater was fixed at 35 degrees so we only got warm showers.
things look like they do in the photos but this place hasn't been maintained for a long time and is not comfortable or relaxing. The couch and matching blue pillows on the bed were grimey and mungey.

This was my second time staying here, and once again, everything was perfect! The house is beautiful, clean, comfortable, and especially located in the heart of the city. description: Super cute and functional noe-bedroom + living room apartment in Tarlabasi, Taksim with a full kitchen. Easy walk from Aiport shuttle stop. reviews.text:
For guests who are sensitive to noise, or for taller people (just when using the toilet 😅), the space may feel a bit noisy or slightly uncomfortable. However, we found it cozy and comfortable overall.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

No complaints. Very good host. Clean place. Good location.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everywhere as a family. If you want a peaceful, comfortable and spacious accommodation, stay at Hakkı Bey Apartment.

reviews.text: Esenay was a great host. She was very responsive and anything that came up, she was quick to remedy. She was very helpful with local recommendations for restaurants and attractions. Her place was perfect for our 3 week trip. We felt right at home. 3 spacious bedrooms with lots of storage. Kitchen had everything we needed. The living room had a beautiful view of the water. We loved watching the boats go by all day and night. It was walking distance to so many things -but beware, lots of steep hills and stairs to get pretty much anywhere. We loved it and would go back and stay there in a heartbeat.

The apartment is located in a nice area, with a supermarket right in front of it. Easy access to Kabataś and waterfront.
The flat itself was nice with a view over Bosphorus, clean but needs some touch up.
The living room lights were defective and we spent hours figuring out how the switch works. I hope Esenay will fix them soon.
The flat is a bit noisy considering the neighbor dogs and non-isolated windows which are looking to the street.
The rest was awesome and our host was very responsive at all the times. Its worth the money that we paid. We will come back again.

We, a family of 5, stayed at Esenay’s place during Christmas holidays and didn’t regret:)
First, Esenay is a very responsive host. I once texted her at night (not expecting her to reply, just so that I don’t forget about it next morning) and she actually replied. The communication was always fast and easy.
Second, the location is top. Very centrally yet not so touristy. And the Bosporus view from the window..unbeatable.
The flat itself is spacious and cozy. There were some minor issues that could have been improved like broken bed (Esenay kindly offered to send a repairman) and the light control panel was not working very well but in general we are satisfied with the price-quality ratio.

Lovely place and a lovely host! My family and I enjoyed our stay very much and will consider this for future trips.
Spacious, well divided with 3 bedrooms, a full kitchen and nice peek onto the Bosporus from the dining table. The 2 bathrooms (one full one half bath) made a lot of things simpler :)
Small note to the light sleepers: The bedrooms are facing the street and even though the windows are double glazed, some noise gets in. Also, at the time of our stay, there we're dogs in the building. They weren't particularly quiet.
The apartment was good, clean and the location was near the tram stop.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text:
I had a really great stay overall. The apartment was very clean, calm, quiet, and comfortable. Everything was exactly as expected, and I truly enjoyed staying there. The host was very helpful and responsive, and the place had a very relaxing atmosphere.
The only small things worth mentioning are that the washing machine and dryer were downstairs, so doing laundry was a bit inconvenient since you had to keep going up and down between cycles. Also, the street has a very steep slope, which might be a little challenging for some people.
The Wi-Fi speed was also a bit slow during my stay, and unfortunately I couldn’t properly have my online meeting because of that. However, the host genuinely tried to fix the issue, and it seemed to be more related to the internet provider than the apartment itself.
Other than these minor points, everything was excellent and I’m very happy with my stay. I would definitely recommend this place.
Had a wonderful stay here! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Quiet neighborhood, easy to relax in. Host was responsive and check-in was easy. 🫶

WiFi connection is a bit unstable.

Unfortunately owner did not respond any of my complain just fixed the issue either internet. Strange part was he ignore my complaint but everyday keep asking if I need anything :)
Additionally there was not even a complimentary water, tissue etc.
Place only come with towel and toilet paper.
And there are small stains on the sofa.
Good thing about the place is the location. Easy access to everywhere.

Cosy, comfy and clean place. Worth value. Miray was very kind and responsive.
Great location with walkable distance to every thing.

This year we have spent our vacation in Istanbul in this beautiful apartment. Apartment is great for two adult persons and addittionally if you have one child it could sleep on sofa. We find location of Cihangir great for all connections (metro, tram, bus, ferry) weather you want to visit European or Asian side of Istanbul. Everything is in 5-10min. walking distance from the apartment. Also area of Cihangir is well known for great restaurants and caffes and for me personally it provides peaceful sorrounding. description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.

reviews.text: Our hosts were incredibly kind, understanding, and helpful, especially as we were dealing with a difficult health-related situation during our stay. They were extremely flexible with our booking, check-in, and changing plans, which we truly appreciated. The apartment was spotlessly clean, very well equipped with almost everything we needed, and the location was fantastic — just a few minutes’ walk from some of the nicest neighborhoods in the area. The only downside for us was that the apartment was a little less quiet and airy than we expected, mainly due to some noise from the neighboring unit, shared area, and building systems. Overall, we had a very positive experience and are especially grateful to our hosts for their kindness, flexibility, and excellent communication.
Excellent stay! Clean apartment, great location, and very helpful host. Special thanks to the cleaning staff for being responsible, professional, and keeping everything perfectly clean.
One of my best Airbnb experiences. A comfortable, clean, and welcoming place with a responsive and friendly host.

Throughout my 4 years of using AirBnB, I can easily say that this was by far the best experience I have had. Batuhan's apart has a wonderful location, super accessible to the best parts of Istanbul (Taksim, Pera, Galata, Karaköy), you could walk to any of these places. The apartment itself was incredibly well designed and very aesthetically furnished. Batuhan and the other co-hosts were very responsive and very proactive and they even left a couple of local treats for me during my stay. I would recommend this to anyone and I can't wait to be back:) Thank you so much!
