Located in the heart of Fatih, this modern 2-bedroom apartment offers an ideal accommodation for guests looking to explore the rich history and culture of Istanbul.

Apartment Features:

Ground Floor

Rooms: 2 Bedrooms, 1 Living Room

Kitchen: Fully equipped and spacious kitchen

Bathroom: Clean and bright 1 bathroom and 1 en-suite bathroom

Internet: Fast and free Wi-Fi

Book your stay now and start enjoying the best of Istanbul!

reviews.text: Had a great time in this apartment, both myself and my family. The apartment is on ground floor, with free public parking right in front. Charming, traditional, non-touristic neighborhood, just 3mins away from Fatih Camii. Many places to eat nearby. Clean, confortable, fully-equipped apartment with easy self-checkin. VERY kind host, open to solve our problems but respecting our privacy. Description and pictures correspond 100%. The only 4/5 stars is the price, all the rest is an honest 5/5 in all aspects. We traveled with 2 aged persons and 1 pregnant lady - the apartment is VERY easily accessible (we moved to and from the apartment with taxi as for 4 people the price was the same as public transport). Much recommended for people who want a change from the overcrowded Sultanahmet area and experience a quiet charming place in the second oldest area of Istanbul. NOT recommended to those who are looking for pubs, nightlife and tourist vibes.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It was exactly as described — clean, cozy, and very comfortable. The location couldn’t be better: close to Unkapanı, Vefa, and Fener stations, which made it easy for us to reach almost every attraction in Istanbul.
We really enjoyed the neighborhood. It’s not too touristy, so we got to experience the real local life — small shops, bakeries, and friendly people all around. The streets can be a bit noisy at night, but it added to the charm and energy of the area. And don’t miss the Wednesday souks nearby — they’re full of colors, local flavors, and an authentic Istanbul vibe.
Muhammet was kind, responsive, and made everything smooth from check-in to check-out. We appreciated all the thoughtful details in the apartment, from the cleanliness to the practical amenities that made us feel right at home.
Overall, we truly loved our stay and would happily come back again. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul!

We stayed in the ground floor apartment. The apartment is furnished beautifully with all the amenities available and is very clean. It was lovely to arrive with everything ready like the soaps, toilet paper kitchen roll and washing powder. Mohammet is an amazing host, very helpful and extremely polite. He gave us information about good places to eat nearby. He sorted out any issues we had straight away. The location is absolutely perfect with restaurants and takeaways just basically around the corner. Our main aim was not to be in a touristy area as we wanted to enjoy local life and local cuisine. Everything is in walking distance, including many local shops. In the past we have been to many apartments in Turkey but we’ve never had an experience like this. We will definitely be coming again.

I had a great stayed at the Airbnb , location near to supermarket & nice restaurant/ cafe & Balat . The nearest tram walking distance around 10min.The apartment is clean , big living room, bedroom spacious as well . Muhammet is a very quick response & action host whenever we in need of help. Recommended place for family's or group.

We stayed at Muhammet’s apartment in the Fatih district and were very satisfied 🤍
The apartment is cozy, clean, and thoughtfully equipped for a comfortable stay. The location is excellent — Istiklal Street and Galata are just 2 metro stops away, making it very convenient to get around.
We would also like to highlight the host — Muhammet was always available and responded instantly to any of our requests, which truly made us feel cared for and at ease during our stay.
Thank you for your hospitality! We would be happy to stay here again ✨

description:
The apartment with a Bosphorus view is located in one of the most touristic districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim/Cihangir, the heart of Beyoğlu

It is in a region where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service and all hotel facilities, where they can comfortably stay as if they were at home

reviews.text: The place had the most beautiful view. The rooms were clean and the staff were very responsive and helpful. There was only a leak on the shower head that kept running, but an easy fix. Taksim square is very close and the trams are easily accessible. Very nice location with excellent staff. I would definately come back.

The view from the room was brilliant. The host was excellent at communicating and was very responsive. Instructions were really easy to follow.
The room was comfortable in an excellent location. The staff at the hotel were really friendly and always happy to help.
We also used the private taxi from the hotel and back, and was really good value for money and an excellent service.
Thank you for our stay!

Çok güzel bir konaklamaydı. Fotoğraflar birebir kaldığımız yeri yansıtıyordu. Kahvaltı da doyurucu ve yeterliydi. Oranın denize bakışı, sabaha karşı Bogazda güneşin dogusunu izlemek çok güzeldi. Çocuklarla kaldık pencereden martı bile besledik. Martı ve vapur seslerini duymak güzeldi. Pencere kapalıyken hiç ses olmuyordu deliksiz uyuduk. Karartma perdeleri de tam kapatıyordu uyumak için rahattı. Sinan beyin iletişimi oldukça iyiydi konaklarken. Fatih beyle de konaklama öncesi ve sonrası hızlı ve iyi bir iletişimimiz oldu. Konum Galataport ve Taksime çok yakın. Karaköy’e de yakın. Biz buralara ve Pera’ya yürüyerek gittik. 5 dk yürüme mesafesinde nitelikli kahveciler, tarihi fırın, yemek yerleri de var. Bir daha kalmak isterdim. Küçük oğlum her seyi ve kahvaltıdaki karpuzu çok beğendiğini soyledi. Çocuklarla kalmak için bu kadar rahat olacağını düşünemezdim her şey için teşekkür ederiz. Harika bir deneyimdi.

This place is great for solo or duo travelers. Centrally located and walkable to many places. But the view was my absolute favorite. Especially at night. You open the windows and let the air in and sounds from the outside is great. You’re also right under the rooftop which is accessible to get a full 360 view of the city. I would recommend this to anyone. And the hotel host is very friendly and always asks how you’re doing and if you need anything.

Strongly recommend this apartment to visitors to Istanbul.
Good location close to Taksim Square and T1 station.
Nice view from the living room and the terrace.
Helpful staffs and daily house keeping services as it’s a hotel-like apartment.

description:
This stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment offers the perfect mix of comfort, convenience, and value.

🛏 Two cozy bedrooms & two modern bathrooms
🍽 Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher
🧺 Washing machine for longer stays
📺 Smart TV with Netflix + fast Wi-Fi
🏋️‍♂️ Gym access
🏊‍♀️ Indoor & outdoor pools
🚇 Just 5 minutes to the metro

Located in one of Istanbul’s best areas — peaceful, central, and walkable.

Perfect for couples, families, and business travelers.

reviews.text: The apartment was modern and clean. We felt very comfortable.The host was very friendly and helpful. Great location, close to shops and restaurants. Highly recommend !!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely incredible stay! This apartment was perfect in every way — clean, cozy, and very comfortable. It truly felt like home and made our stay in Istanbul even more special.
But the highlight was without a doubt the host. He is one of the kindest and most welcoming people we’ve ever met. Always smiling, extremely helpful, and genuinely caring, he went above and beyond to make sure we had the best possible experience. We absolutely adored him!
I cannot recommend this place enough. If you’re coming to Istanbul, don’t hesitate for a second — this is the place to stay. We would 100% come back! Thanks for everything Mohammad 🙏
Great location, close to the metro, little grocery store nearby.
Amazing place, with amazing people. Super close to the metro station, right next to a place where you can drink your coffee and eat your breakfast.❤️
Thanks for everything all was good and your asst Mohmad was very helpful

description: Our apartment offers comfortable accommodation for up to four guests with two bedrooms. In the spacious living room, you can enjoy a movie night, play Xbox, or listen to music with the Marshall sound system. The open kitchen, bright bathroom, and practical amenities make it suitable for both short and long stays. The most enjoyable space is the terrace, decorated with seating areas—perfect for sipping your coffee or having pleasant evening conversations accompanied by music.Located on -1 floor

reviews.text:
Modern apartment with all the amenities and spotless clean. Location is excellent with some shops open 24/7 nearby. Huge TV which was nice during the World Cup.
Only thing to be aware of is that the apartment is at -1 (as indicated in the listing). The bedrooms are right below the street but near the building entrance. You will hear some noise from people walking by, entering the building in the middle of the night or cars/motorbikes passing by. There isn’t much the host can do here, so bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper like me. I brought one and slept without issues.
We loved the location and will book again if we need an accommodation in Istanbul. Thank you for everything.

I had a wonderful stay at Zeynep’s apartment. The check-in instructions were very clear and easy to follow, which made the whole arrival process smooth and stress-free. The location is fantastic, close to all types of public transportation, as well as many great restaurants and bars, making it very convenient to explore the area.
Zeynep was a very helpful host and always responded quickly whenever I had a question. The apartment itself was extremely neat and clean, and everything was well maintained. All the equipment worked perfectly, which made the stay very comfortable.
One of the highlights was the large and beautiful terrace with a lovely seating area, it was a great place to relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
Overall, it was a 10/10 experience. I would definitely come back and highly recommend Zeynep’s place to anyone visiting the area.

We stayed at Zeynep's place for 10 days and honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.Her place made me regret staying at other places during out trip.The moment we walked in,we noticed the little gift on the coffee table,the YUMMY floral scent,the most beautiful interior design etc..As someone who is a clean freak,I almost cried happy tears because this apartment was SPOTLESS and beautifully maintained. My husband had to work from home and it had everything we needed for a comfortable stay and workspace. So many clean towels in both rooms,multiple slippers in unopened packages,iron,iron board,vacuum, washing machine,pots & pans..you name it!We also had a lovely outdoor space we unfortunately could not use due to rainy weather but it looked beautiful and so serene.What truly made the stay special was the host,Zeynep: kind, responsive, and always willing to help with any questions.I felt completely at home from the moment I arrived & I’d happily stay here again and AGAIN!

We had a wonderful stay at Zeynep's cozy Kadıköy apartment with my partner and her daughter. The place was spotlessly clean with new amenities, and the temperature was perfectly warm during the chilly January days. The little private yard area was a nice touch, and the Xbox was a fun surprise that kept us entertained!
Zeynep was responsive and helpful throughout, making check-in and check-out completely hassle-free. The Kadıköy location was convenient for exploring the neighborhood's cafes and markets.
One small note for future guests: the apartment is on the basement level, which wasn't an issue for us but worth knowing beforehand.
We'd happily return and recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Amazing! definitely will repeat.
Bedding was comfortable. lots of trendy, tasty, gourmet places all around the area. Great communication & very professional & reliable! Impeccably clean and spotless. Wifi & table setup was perfect so could be very productive too. Love the place a lot.

description:
Discover your island escape in the heart of Büyükada.

This stylish 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment offers a comfortable and thoughtfully designed space, ideal for families or groups of friends. Start your day on the spacious balcony, perfect for enjoying the island air and slow mornings. Step outside to explore nearby cafés, beaches, and Büyükada’s historic streets, all just minutes away. With modern amenities and a calm island atmosphere, this home is a perfect retreat for your stay.

reviews.text: Konum ev her şey harikaydı. Ev tertemizdi. Mahramiyet sağlanması adına ve güneş içinde perdeler eklenmişti. Tek sıkıntı karşı apartmanda oturan ve ara ara kendi üst katında oturan kişilere de argo konuşup bağıran komşuydu. Onun dışında evde harika vakit geçirdik. Huzurluydu. Yatak odaları ve yepyeni banyolar çok güzeldi. Ev sahibi sorulara hemen yanıt verdi. Kurumsal bir firma tarafından yönetildiği için hiç sorun yaşamadık.

The apartment is stunning. Located in the heart of the island, however, it’s very silent in there. There’s absolutely everything you might need in there from washing powder and dishwasher tablets to spices for cooking. The interior is perfect, beds are very comfortable, and the views from the balconies are picturesque. This is the greatest experiences I’ve ever had with Airbnb.

Our stay was great, the house was even better than the pictures! It was very clean, easy to reach, and everything about the stay was smooth and hassle-free. Communication with the owners was quick and easy, which made the whole experience even better. Thank you for the wonderful hosting! This will definitely be the place I stay whenever I come back to the islands.

Fantastic stay with every comfort you could wish for!
The old colonial terrace was magical, sipping tea and watching the twinkling lights of Istanbul.
Communication excellent and shower rooms were wonderful.
Will definitely return!

I don’t know what to begin with… the beautiful view on Istanbul from the terrace, or the gorgeous family dining table outside, or the comfortable living room area, or spacious bedrooms, or beautiful interior design elements… It all was so beautiful!!! My family and I loved every moment we spent there!
This home helped us relax, stay calm, and enjoy our vacation on the island. It felt like an oasis of calmness, where we wanted to retreat to after exploring the neighborhood and the nature around.
Thank you for creating such an amazing space, so that families like mine could come together to enjoy each other’s company while exploring a beautiful area around.

description: Great location. Marmaray and Metro are 1 minute away. 2min walk to Capacity and Caroussel Shopping Mall, 5min walk to the beach TV, air conditioning, computer, internet, etc. are available. The suite is not a room in a hotel or apartment, it is a studio apartment... The sink and toilet of your apartment are right in front of your door, the opposite apartment uses the toilet in front of your door as a sink and toilet

reviews.text: Aynı fotoğraflardaki gibiydi daire yatak ve oda çok temizdi kimse rahatsız etmedi Murat bey baya ilgiliydi tam bi fiyat performans kesinlikle tavsiye ederim
Sorulara hızlı cevap verdi aska bekletmedi sunduğu imkanlar çok iyiydi oda gayet temiz ve güvenilir
Bakırköy’ün tam kalbinde olan bir lokasyonda fiyatına göre harika bir imkan sunuyor, otel konseptinde düşünülmeye çalışılmış ki başarılı da olunmuş. Her şey için teşekkürlerimi iletiyorum
İyiydi meydana da aşırı yakın
Kolay ulaşım rahat giriş

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text:
Öncelikle her şey fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Evin dizaynı, eşyalar vs gayet güzeldi. Sadece saatler ve kişi sayısı konusunda daha esnek olabileceklerini düşünüyorum. Bir arkadaşımızı davet etmek istedik gerekirse ek ücret karşılığında fakat kabul etmediler. Biz gece çok geç saatte giriş yaptık(00:00-01:00) dolayısıyla çıkış saatini uzatmak istedik yine ek ücret karşılığı o da kabul edilmedi. Çok hareketli olmayan bir dönemde gittiğimiz için tolere edilebilirdi.
Ayrıca evde su, kahve, ekstra peçete gibi ihtiyaçların da bulunması gerektiğini düşünüyorum.
Bunların dışında herhangi bir sorun yoktu bizim için manzara, konum, temizlik vs son derece iyi.
Öncelikle manzara çok güzel. Ev tertemizdi ve eşyalar konforluydu. Ev sahibini ile iletişime geçtiğimizde hızlı bir şekilde taleplerimiz karşıladı. İyi bir konaklama deneyimiydi.

The place was beautifully designed and very clean. From the pictures and description it seemed like it is a beachfront property but the beach is in fact across a busy street from the property. This was somewhat disappointing.

Akıllı TV ile ilgili sorun yaşadık ve onun haricinde 3 odadan birinde muhtemelen alttan ıısıtma sistemi sistemi o odada çalışmıyordu. Gece çok soğuktu. Onun haricinde 10/9 bir konaklama yaşadık arkadaşlarımla. Bizimle iletişimde kalan çalışanların emeğine sağlık

Amazing and beautiful 🤩!
Me and my family fell so deeply in love that we happily extended our stay. ❤️ It was an unforgettable stay in every possible way. From the moment we arrived, we felt surrounded by warmth and genuine hospitality. The host and the security staff were absolutely wonderful, kind, and caring.
Every sunrise over the sea, every gentle breeze, and every peaceful moment felt like a dream. 🤩 The breathtaking views, the soothing sound of the waves, and the elegant interior created a place where my family felt truly happy.
Thank you for making our stay so magical. ✨

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text:
Good location and value for money as a hotel in this area.
The only problem I faced was the noise, especially the noise coming from downstairs (hotel lobby) as there is no door. But some noise is passing the walls from the nearby rooms
The team was great, nice, and supportive.
Thank you

I enjoyed my stay
The place is in a business area. There will be some noise but not till late.
The check in is so easy and the building is clean with friendly and helpful staff. It’s a nice please just to sleep and shower so you are out and about in the city
This was my aim and I liked it. Will definitely use it for my next solo trip.

The place is modest but clean and offers easy access to the main attractions of the Old Town. The area isn't exactly quiet, but it's full of local life: shops, stalls, good food, and wonderful sweets. The hosts are very kind and helpful. They're just people who are like that; they don't have to force themselves to be like that at work. The atmosphere was wonderful! It was hard to leave... If you're a globetrotter and appreciate discovering not only places but also people's souls and other cultures, you have to be there.
And send them greetings from Agata!
Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
affordable and private. host is really nice and helpful. walking distance to all things need. thank you.

description:
Rum-Otto Pera is a warm city apartment that combines the magic of old Istanbul with modern touches.
It is only a few minutes away from Istiklal Avenue and only 10 minutes away from Taksim. A hidden spirit among the historical buildings✨
You can hear the birds while sipping your morning coffee on the balcony in the morning and feel the breeze from Galata in the evening.
The house is a simple but characterful living space in every detail: high ceilings, dim lights, calm decor and the spirit unique to Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews because I understand hosting is how many people make a living. Unfortunately, this is one of the few times I feel compelled to warn future guests.
We checked out early because of multiple issues: unreliable Wi-Fi that dropped during work meetings, no obvious place to dispose of trash, three spiders inside, a duvet too small for two people, a strong moldy smell on arrival, and constant construction noise. One night, jackhammering started around 11 p.m.
The apartment is on the 4th floor with an extremely steep staircase that wasn’t clearly disclosed. I’m a fit 40-year-old male who trains daily, and I still injured my shoulder carrying our luggage. An older guest or anyone with mobility issues would struggle.
The surrounding area felt dirty and unsafe, and even our taxi driver commented on the neighborhood.
I understand some issues are outside the host’s control, but taken together I cannot recommend this property.

the location was amazing, the apartment felt like home and the hosts were super responsive and friendly.
you are right in the hustle & bustle which is great to explore the area by foot, have lots of food and shop options nearby and same for public transportation- with that being said it can get a bit noisy but we still slept alright.
The kitchen is very minimally amended- for example there are wine glasses but no bottle opener- so before you want to enjoy food and drink at the apartment make sure you have everything you need. We mostly dined out anyway which I would recommend with all the tasty options :)
the bathroom is very small and wasn’t up to our standard clean wise, but the hosts said they would take care of things immediately so this should not be a problem for other guests hopefully.
All in all we definitely recommend this apartment for a great short term stay in Istanbul 🫶✨

Great place in general, good location, pretty views, rooftop was nice to have. Nice living room.
The bedroom is really small, had to rearrange the bed to get through the door, so was the ensuit.
And the rooftop was not cleaned.
Also some issues with the electricity but the host fixed it.
Would stay again

Great location, amazing restaurants nearby. It was clean and just as described. Could benefit from some closet space or even a few hooks.
Would definitely stay here again!

The flat was well located, being about 20-30 mins walk from the major parts of Istanbul. It was very, very noisy as it's next to a main road so would recommend baring that in mind, especially in the hotter months when you'll want the windows open. It was small, but it's perfect for two people - but could do with more hanging space.
The hosts were super responsive and helpful, including letting us leave our luggage with them after check out, which was really great.
There were a few marks on the sofa, and one of the side lamps didn't work in the bedroom, but the bed was really comfortable and the curtains really blocked out the light.
Overall, it's a good spot if you want to be fairly central but not right in the thick of it!

description: This duplex apartment is in a building with two apartments, in the famous neighborhood Balat/Fener where the heart of the Roman Constantinople and Ottoman İstanbul. It has a livingroom, 2 bedrooms, equipped kitchen and with 1 wc & 1 bathroom. It is walking distance to tram, bus, sightseeing, cafes, restaurants, bars and shopping. It has designed for a cosy and fulfilled Istanbul vacation. This is residential neighbourhood, visitors should be quite and respectful to the residents around.

reviews.text: Superb caring, helpful host, gives great recommendations. New clean quiet house, very comfortable bed,beautiful fluffy white towels. Functional kitchen. Great location. I love Fener and Balat for its many eclectic coffee shops, restaurants, it's multi culturalism, it's vibe. Plus it's easy to get to the main attractions by tram, bus and ferry and the promenade at the Golden Horn looking over to Galata tower. We are a fit and healthy couple in our mid and late Seventies and we managed the steep and narrow stairs well. We 100% recommend Taylan's two story apartment.

Apartment is really cozy and comfortable with unique design with 2 floors. everything was clean, kitchen with everything you need.
location is also good, near Fener stop. nearby a lot of places with food, coffee and souvenirs and just nice streets and buildings.
AC in one bedroom and living room, another bedroom with fan. temperature was comfortable regulated in every room.
Host sent a lot of information about restaurants and clear instructions about transport from airports. It was nice.
Highly recommend to stay in this apartment.

Cozy two-floor apartment for 2-3 people. The kitchen is good, with everything you need to cook a simple meal. Big fridge, washing machine. The living room was on the other flor from the kitchen, a liitle strange, but funny :)
Two comfortable bedrooms, toilet and shower are convenient and clean. But be ready to go up and down the stairs a lot!
The neighborhood is calm and full of beautiful old buildings, restaurants and cafes in a minute walking. Shops and groceries are also close. Good transport connection bus tram, bus, or ferry.
During the stay we asked for the extra sheets and the landlord provided them very fast! Later also helped with the local recommendations. We enjoyed staying with Taylan!

Well located! Situated in Fener area very close to many restaurants, bus & tram stations. We really enjoyed our stay. Just a note on the layout of the apartment : As 70 years old, the two flights of stairs were very steep.
The single bedroom, a shower & the kitchen is on one level after the 1st flight of stairs. The lounge, main bedroom, the toilet & separate basin is on the next level. Once we worked out where to leave what, (eg we left our suitcases on the bed of the single bedroom as the shower is on the same level), we were sorted!

Taylan is a WONDERFUL host! The apartment is adorable, super clean, and very close to everything. There are lots of restaurants and shops & the metro & ferry is a very short walk away. I would definitely stay again. Thanks!

description: This modern and carefully designed apartment offers a comfortable and enjoyable stay thanks to its cleanliness, style, and functionality. With its open-plan kitchen, cozy seating area, and comfortable bed, you will feel right at home. Thanks to its central location, it offers easy access to everywhere. It is suitable for short- and long-term stays. The apartment is meticulously cleaned after each guest. Wi-Fi, TV, and all essential amenities are available. The photos accurately represent the apartment. It is a detached property with a garden.

reviews.text:
The host was friendly and check-in was easy, and the apartment was clean. However, I think the listing photos present the apartment in a much more flattering light than the reality. It felt smaller and more modestly furnished than I expected from the listing.
The location is in a very local residential neighborhood rather than a tourist area. To reach the apartment, you enter through a black metal gate into a narrow walkway beside the building. Immediately next door is a construction/storage area, and the street itself is a typical working residential street. None of this is necessarily a problem, but I think prospective guests should know that the surroundings are quite different from the impression created by the listing photos.
There was considerable neighborhood noise from children playing, dogs barking, cats, and seagulls until around midnight. The air conditioner is only in the living room. It kept the apartment tolerable but did not cool the bedroom sufficiently, so we had to sl

Nice ground floor apartment, well equipped, complementary drinks in the fridge, clean and had many shops within 5-10 minutes walk. Excellent and prompt communication by the host Mustafa. We didn't have internet after leaving the airport so ended up missing a picture the host shared of the outside gate which would have made finding the place easier. However, a friendly neighbor contacted Mustafa and he came round in about 10 minutes to assist us in person.
The entrance is though a black gate on the side of the apartment block, not the main apartment door. The outside gate pushes against the lock making it difficult for the key to turn - the trick is to pull the gate with your other hand to release the pressure then turn clockwise. These were minor niggles we soon dealt. Would definitely stay here again, many thanks Mustafa

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev son derece şık, temiz ve konforluydu; fotoğraflardakiyle birebir aynı. Merkezi konumu ve kolay giriş-çıkış süreci büyük avantajdı. Her detay özenle düşünülmüş. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih ederiz.

Çok keyifli ve konforlu bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Ev son derece temiz, şık ve özenle hazırlanmıştı. Herşey düşünülmüş eksiksizdi. Konumu da oldukça güzel. Ev sahibinin ilgisi ve misafirperverliği ayrıca çok değerliydi. Her şey için teşekkür ederim, kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğimiz bir yer.

İlan sahibi ile iletişim problemi olmadı. Ancak gece geç saatlere kadar sokaktan gelen çocuk ve hayvan seslerinden dolayı uyuyamadık. Evin genel temizliği iyiydi, kullanılabilecek bütün eşyalar mevcuttu. Konut mahalle arasında bulunuyor, park yeri bulmak zor oldu.

description:
Welcome to this Luxury 2-bedroom apartment located in Atakent area, near Tema World Shopping Mall.

🌿 This stylish apartment offers spacious living with a fully equipped kitchen, free access to indoor pool, spa, sauna, hamam and gym, and also includes daily free housekeeping service.

📍 The apartment is conveniently located close to Tema World Mall, restaurants, cafés, and shopping options, making it a perfect choice for both leisure and business stays.

We wish you a pleasant stay! ✨

reviews.text: Amazing. Private. Peacefull. Elegant. Clean. More than what i expected to trully speak. I dont usually write public reviews but this one got my heart. Especially our host. Made me feel like i was at my home. Very friendly. Super easy communication even at midnight. The apartment was really amazing. It had everything someone could ask for. I would really recommend this stay. Really super wow. Every time i come back to istanbul im reserving this stay. Just wow
Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. İlgi ve alakaları çok iyiydi, otel temiz ve konforluydu. Her şey gayet güzeldi, tekrar tercih ederiz. 🌸

Konaklama öncesi ve sonrası çok profesyonel destek sağlamdı. İrem hanım giriş öncesi ve çıkış sonrası çok yardımcı oldu. Temizlik düzen 10/10 du. Teşekkür ediyor ve herkese kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum.

Çok güzel bir konaklama gerçekleştirdim. Eve girdiğimde şok oldum çünkü her yer çok düzenli ve temizdi eşyaların kalitesi ve güzelliği beni benden aldı. Minnacık bir toz bile yoktu evde. Güzel bir deneyim yaşadım lobi’ye her söylediğim şey veya istediğim şeyler hemen gerçekleşti. Herkese öneririm.
luxury stay outstanding amenities and facilities, highly recommended.

description:
Welcome to York House.

Here, we offer you warm, stylish and new rooms in the center of Istanbul, as well as a sincere and friendly service.

Our facility is five minutes walking distance to the seaside its also ten minutes walking distance to the Grand Bazaar and Beyazit Square, and fifteen minutes walking distance to Sultan Ahmet Square and Hagia Sophia Mosque.

We look forward to welcoming you and having you be our guest .

reviews.text: This is a very lovely hotel made even more special by the phenomenal host, Gokhan who could not have been kinder or more accommodating. He is quite possibly the best Airbnb host we have ever had. The hotel is in a quiet road opposite a church. There is a lovely reception area. The room was very comfortable and clean. The terrace upstairs is a real treat with an amazing atmosphere and beautiful view. Incredible value. I would not hesitate in recommending this accommodation.

İşletme fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi odalar düzenli ve temiz. Gökhan bey her konuda çok ilgili ve misafirperverliği çok güzel. En güzel yanı da terasındaki manzara.. Fiyat/performans bir otel, konumu çok iyi kolayca her yeri gezebildik.

The hotel is in a convenient area for exploring Istanbul. It sits down the hill from the station, and the walk up became something we looked forward to every day. Along the way are little spots selling freshly squeezed orange juice, which became one of my favorite stops.
Istanbul is a city you experience by walking, so definitely explore around the hotel. There are so many boutiques, shops, great restaurants, and little places to discover nearby.
Gökhan was very welcoming and attentive, always available when we needed something and full of great recommendations. We spent a lot of time sitting outside and enjoyed our conversations with him. He even offered us some of his food at times, which was very kind. A cat also gave birth to kittens outside the hotel, and seeing how much Gökhan cared for them was really sweet.
Don’t hesitate to talk to Gökhan or ask for recommendations. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Istanbul. Thank you, Gökhan!
Responsive, helpful and friendly host. Clean and nice rooms, beautiful view from the rooftop.

It was a good location, close to main attractions and to get around. The balcony for breakfast, and other times, overlooking the Marmary Sea was the highlight. And the breakfast there was a highlight, as was Gokhon's generosity, whether it was food, laundry or advice. The rooms are small but clean and workable. This was a valuable introduction to Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Da wir es so toll fanden, habe ich die Bewertung auf Deutsch, Englisch und Türkisch geschrieben!

We definitely recommend this lovely apartment. It was very clean, very cozy and we loved the balcony. Everything promised was available: Towels, Shampoo etc. Utensils you need to cook and even 40l water, milk, cheese, a fresh bred Llydmyla had organized to enable a perfect first night. As she calculated, the taxi cost about 20€ and because we arrived in the evening it was very very thoughtful that she had bought something to eat. Of course after a shower we ate something in a restaurant not far away from the apartment but because of that we felt very welcome. Air conditioner, washmaschine + dryer, even a dishwasher and everything she had described, was available. We were very pleased that a supermarket and the metro station were very close so we could easily reach every place we wanted to see. By using the metrocards which Llymyla had given us before, we saved half the price of each ticket and could also avoid long queues.
All in all we were extremly happy about this apartment and really want to come again!
Apartman çok rahat, çok güzel ve çok temiz! Her şeyden önce apartmanın balkonu sevdik çünkü ordan denzi gördük. Lllydmyla çok yardımsever ve sevgili. Süpermarket ve mağazalar yakındalar. Bundan başka Sultanahmet camı ve liman da yakındalar. Oraya geri dönmek istiyoruz!
Die Wohnung hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen! Das Taxi vom Atatürk Flughafen hat wie von der Gastgeberin angegeben weniger als 20€ gekostet. In der Wohnung erwartete uns die Gastgeberin Llydmyla, die uns willkommen hieß und uns alles zeigte. Wir fühlten uns direkt wohl. Meiner Mutter kochte Llydmyla türkischen Kaffee und da sie auch noch u.a. für 40 l Trinkwasser, Kaffee, ein frisches Brot und Käse gesorgt hatte, brauchten wir nach der Ankunft auch nicht direkt einkaufen.
Reine Handtücher, Shampoo, Seife, Fön, Spülmaschine, Waschmaschine, Trockner, Küche, alles, was man zum Kochen braucht und Klimaanlage standen uns wie versprochen zur Verfügung. Die Wohnung war frisch geputzt, die Betten bezogen und sogar mit einer Rose dekoriert. Das aller schönste an der Wohnung war aber der große Balkon mit Blick aufs Meer. Auch wenn wir viel unterwegs waren, haben wir stets genossen dort zu frühstücken und zu entspannen!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist ebenfalls optimal! Der Supermarkt ist 2 Minuten entfernt (und jede Menge Kiosks, die noch länger offen haben), die Haltstelle "Findikli" ist auch ganz nah, von wo aus man u.a. bequem zur Altstadt (Sultanahmet) gelangt. Um shoppen zu wollen, brauchten wir auch nur max. 10 Minuten laufen, dann war man quasi in der Fußgängerzone.
Was auch echt praktisch war, war, dass Llydmyla sogar für die Metro vorgesorgt hatte. Sie gab uns Karten, die man aufladen konnte, wodurch man nirgendwo anstehen und nur die Hälfte zahlen musste.
Also Fazit: Alles super! Die Wohnung empfehlen wir absolut weiter! Die Gastgeberin ist sehr liebenswert! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und möchten bald wiederkommen! :-)

The apartment - Exactly like shown in pics, modern, cosy, clean and well maintained and easily accessible by walk/cab. The location - Perfect, walking distance from Istiklal street but just distant enough in a quiet and upscale neighborhood. The host - the best part of all, she is ALWAYS available, helpful, resourceful and goes an extra mile to help and accomodate your requests. 5 stars for that. This is a gem of a combination, so if your next stop is Istanbul, this should end your search for the perfect place to stay.

We stayed in Lyudmylas apartment for a prolonged weekend. The apartment is perfect situated close to Taksim and the waterfront and only a few minutes walk fromthe tram stop. The apartment is exactly as described and Lyudmyla was a very welcoming and helpfull host.

It was amazing staying in Lyudmyla’s flat, she’ll take care of you as you were her family... it’s great to know that you can count on a local when you travel! She was extremely responsive and helpful when we had some questions,
The flat is ideally located in one of the many sloping streets of Istanbul, right in-between Taksim place and Findikli Tram station so you can reach any place of interest in couples of minutes.. the flat is at the 4th floor without elevator (maybe not that common in Istanbul buildings?) but the spacious balcony and its view really worth it!
It is also exceptionally well equipped and has all you need for relaxing, cooking and so on..
For those who have children there’s also a playing area just nearby the tram station, overlooking the Bosphore! Thank you Lyudmyla!

It is a great place to stay in Istanbul, super close to Taksim Square. The view is awesome and in a very nice neighborhood. The house was clean and Luydmyla welcomed us personally. Just a headsup that her place is on the 4th floor and no elevator...

description:
Yildirim City Home's is located three munites from Taksim square which is the heart of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The location is the best place to choose in Istanbul. Proximity to Istiklal Street and Taksim Square with a flat surface (no uphill) is the prominent advantage. There is also no street noise during the night.
Halil is a very kind person. I even arrived two hours earlier and he told me to enter the house and not to wait outside. He arranged a taxi for us to return to the airport and answered every question we had.
The unit is on the third floor and if there is an old person with you, it may be difficult to climb up the stairs, but we were young and it was not a problem at all.
The water in the house is very hot and the house was also clean, but if you plan to stay for more than two or three days, it is not possible to prepare food because the electric stove is single, and the house is a little smaller than the photos (more similar to a simple hotel room than an apartment).
But for a short stay in Istanbul at this price, it's great.

There are several plus (+) and minus (-) points. I've booked this falt for a 2 weeks and have to retreat next day after the taking (-) expirience. Lets put them on table:
- Noise. Anyway this is touristic city center. Many flats here affected by terrible noise during the night and early morning as well (why locals start loudly talk on the street at 7 onclok idk).
- Internet. For basic browsing it could be good. But for me I need to have long online chats with voice and video. WiFi routers shared for all house ! There are 2 WiFi point. One of them becomes down many time, another one do the very bad quality of WiFi signal
- Kitchen. Very few items can help you with cooking.
+ Halil really good in communications.
+ Halil leave in the same building so will meet you on any time and in few moments will be in apartment to help
+ Apartments looks nise.
My conclusion: if you want to fire the nigh, eat and drink etc - and you have to have a short distance to the touristic center - this would be for you. If you want cook - it is not for you. If you want to have quite and noiseless evenining - it is not for you. If you want to have work time - it is also not for you. So this why I have to lost my money with Halil and change my apartments to another one (few dollars up in price and i get everything in flat, good bathroom and modern fully equiped kitchen)

Halil was very helpful and responsive, the location is extremely convenient : close to the famous Istikal street and Taksim square, infinite number of restaurants and cafés and shops. The room was clean and comfortable, except the shower walls would need a little love (restoring the grout). I still strongly recommend the place for the whole experience, it was perfect for us!

Halil was an amazing host and the place was right in the heart of Beyoglu, few minutes walk from famous Istiklal. House was clean, everything looked exactly the same with pictures and check-in was flexible. I have also requested few extra things such as towels, paper and late check out, all of them were provided immediately. I have seen a few negative comments about the bathroom, but I haven't had any issues. Also, neighbourhood was calm during the weekdays even though the house is placed in a central area. Overall it was a great experience and great value for money. Definitely recommended if you are looking for a stay in Istanbul.

To break it down into simple pros n cons:

Pros:
1) Excellent location just off Istikal street and Taksim square.
2) Excellent connectivity options all day (public transport, cabs)
3) Halil was very responsive to communication.
Cons:
1) Apartment is functional but definitely Not as nice as it looks in the photos. The bathroom was a big let-down.
2) Apartment is very run-down. Could do better with upkeep.
3) Wifi was an issue. And Halil tried to correct the issues. It was fine while it worked, but kept disconnecting.
Overall - 3/5. But with potential to be much better.

description:
Dear guests,
We are Turkish/German couple living mainly in Berlin but we love spending time in fascinating Istanbul. We have a historical flat which is located in the heart of the oldest and most charming part of Istanbul Çukurcuma - Cihangir is well known for its many antiques & curio shops, hidden gems of all kinds. Be aware that you will be experiencing and enjoying Istanbul here at its best especially if you are a lover of history, culture, art, good food, etc.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Elif's flat if you are visiting Istanbul, from a few nights to a medium to long-term stay. The images are a perfect representation of the flat - only it is more beautiful, more relaxing, and more than one could possibly expect until walking through the beautiful original wooden front doors. The flat is well-equipped and it is very clean and feels so well cared for. The kitchen is a dream, especially the beautiful professional-style oven that is any cook's dream.
Even though my stay was during Istanbul's winter, it was warm enough most days to have the balcony doors open, especially when cooking. I could hear in the distance the sound of air horns from ships on the Bosphorus, and the chatter on the streets below, reminding me of the vibrant and lovely city that is Istanbul. At the same time, the flat is quiet and peaceful when the doors and windows are closed - I slept soundly every night!
One of the three stools that sit with the kitchen island is also the perfect place to hang out for hours, drinking coffee or tea and reading, working on your laptop, or sipping an evening glass of wine while cooking. The view from the loft - as well as the balcony - is quite special, especially at sunrise, sunset, and after dark. Their is great space to stow luggage out of the way. The washing and drying machines are an absolute wonderful treat for a longer stay. The bed is so comfortable and the bathroom and shower rivals a 5-star hotel. Elif is responsive and so kind, and the check in process was seamless and clever. There is no elevator and the flat is up two flights, so if you have heavy luggage get some help from your taxi and tip him well!
Think of it as a daily workout to relax your legs after climbing up and down the hills of Istanbul! The neighbors are so lovely. The neighborhood is one of my favorites and there is so much to do right outside the front door, even during the current COVID lockdown. I stay in many AirBnB when I travel and I have to say, Elif's place was among the best. It's quite a special place in a very special city in one of the most beautiful countries in the world.
Thank you, Elif, for the beautiful space and place and for being a wonderful host! teşekkür ederim!

This was definitely one of the best Airbnb experiences we've ever had, probably the best. First of all, communication with Elif was very efficient – she always replied quickly and gave very easy-to-follow instructions on the check in and other questions. Secondly, this apartment has what I think is the best location there could be in Istanbul if you want to experience the city to it's fullest. You can easily walk or get by public transport quickly enough to all of the sights in the European side, the ferries to Asian side and the Islands are also in walking distance, but also you get the prettiest streets with art galleries, designer stores, vintage and a great assortment of restaurants and bars (many serve take-away and in good weather you can enjoy the food at nearby steps with great Bosphorus views!) as well as a lot of very good (3d wave) coffee places – and all this in the 10 min walking distance from the apartment!
As for the apartment itself: it is a unique place – not a generic airbnb experience. You have to walk up to the second floor (there is no lift), but there are so many steps waiting for you on the hills of Istanbul that these two flights you won't even notice. Inside, you get very high ceilings, huge and very cozy master bedroom with a hammok-type chair, a room-turned-huge-walk-in-closet, great designer bathroom with very nice water pressure, and a spacious kitchen-living room with a mezzanine. Upstairs (on the mezzanine) there is a sofa (it could be turned into a bed, but not a very comfortable one, there are fine extra mattresses for sleeping there though), and a second bathroom with a washer and a dryer (keep in mind that this bathroom doesn't have a fully closing door, just a curtain). The kitchen deserves another mention: there is a huge gas stove, and it's really equipped for any type of cooking - there are a lot of pots&pens&plates etc., a large fridge, a dishwasher. Also it's very conveniently and beautifully designed – you would even enjoy that there are reasons to cook during lockdown (buy supplies at a great Carrefour gourmet 5 min from the house). Finally, the balcony. It was the greatest surprise for us: it's not just spacious and has comfortable furniture, but it faces sunset and has an amazing view over the city towards Galata tower and the mosques of Sultanahmet. Just the view from the balcony is reason enough to stay here!
All in all – we do recommend this place if you wish to have a really great Istanbul experience.

Elif's apartment is very clean, comfortable and convenient. I highly recommend it to stay.
location - it felt safe any time of the day. it's located in the neighborhood with lots of
restaurants, bars and cafes so it was super convenient. the old city is practically walking distance (15 mins walk). but the tram (2 stops to the spice bazaar) is also only 5 mins away (all downhill from the apartment so it was easy too). it's also relatively close to Taksim sq so it was convenient for shopping as well.
amenities - the kitchen is nice and pretty much fully equipped. i wanted to try out as much of local food as possible so i didn't cook but if i were to cook, the kitchen was ready for it. the apartment is also clean and comfortable and spacious. it also has a nice bathroom with a super nice shower on downstairs. If i had to nitpick something, it could be noisy on Fri and/or Sat night with some street noise but it wasn't so bad.

We stayed for 2 months and everything was very nice. The neighborhood is good and the appartment is definitely located on the best street. It’s a rather calm place. Here you can find a lot of nice cafés, small shops, supermarkets and more. It’s less than 10 minutes walk from Istiklal avenue, taksim square, also near the galata tower and it’s very easy to take the Metro or tram to other popular places. The appartment was clean and just as beautiful as in the pictures. It’s a spacious place and the kitchen is very good. The balcony was super nice. Everything was well prepared for our arrival and we felt well at home. OMG: Elif is a great host, she was very helpful and did everything for us to have a pleasent stay. Don’t miss out on this! (seriously)

My wife and I found the apartment very comfortable and the amenities were very accessible and useful. The level of the kitchen was an impressive. It has a big 6 burner stove with oven as well as an espresso machine and plenty of dishes and utensils to cook nice meals. The washer and dryer in the loft area was a useful amenity. It was unseasonably warm during our stay and the air conditioner was having a small issue, Elif investigated the problem and had a technician to the house for the repair within an hour of discovering the problem. Elif was always pleasant and very responsive when I had any questions. I whole-heartedly recommend this property for anyone looking for a locale in a bustling neighborhood in Istanbul.

description: Located in Şişli and with Taksim Square reachable within a 19-minute walk, our apartment has concierge services, rooms, a shared lounge, free WiFi throughout the property. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, room service, free daily housekeeping and currency exchange for guests.

reviews.text:
I stayed at Beddington Residence Sisli for 4 days and then extended for 2 more days. Someone mentioned the neighborhood is a little rough, it’s actually very nice neighborhood to me, not as high end but mostly locals surrounded by restaurants, grocery stores, supermarket, and Metro/Train which I preferred. Few blocks from the area is high end neighborhood where you can find Gucci store, Chanel, etc and also Zara, Sephora and other second tier brands.
The check in is 2PM but we arrived early in the morning around 8AM because we took overnight flight, they let me stayed in an unoccupied room to relax and hang out with my family until our room was ready. So we went out to explore the neighborhood. One of the hosts Muhammad texted me at 3PM that the room was ready, and when we got to the room he already put our luggage inside, and the room looked exactly like in the picture, clean but smaller than the picture shown which was not an issue for us!
TV was not working for 2 days until we figured it out, it needed extension outlets and I have requested which was delivered within hour. The remote need to be directed exactly toward the little receiver next to a TV.
The hosts Basar, Mohammad and others were very courteous, friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Mohammad also helped us getting Istanbul Card which was not easy to activate, he had to call the municipality, and once it’s activated you can use the card for almost every public transportation!
Overall our stayed were very pleasant and I will stay there again when I come back to Istanbul.
PS: They also helped you get Covid test for return trip by inviting Nurses to the lobby

Communication and check-in were very smooth, in fact both receptionists were really nice. The place is located just a few streets away from a nice Nisantasi area, and is a bit rougher than what I expected. It's also much darker than on the photos. There was noise from the construction next door, and you could hear the neighbors flush or use the sink. The listing says it meets "Enhanced Clean" Airbnb standards, but In the middle of Covid, when the cleaners came to clean the room, neither of them was wearing a masksor gloves, so I had to decline the service.

Basar was very helpful and responsive during the stay, had issue with shower and was sorted asap. Good location near osmanbey metrol 1 stop to taskim and walk to nearby cafe and food places. Mohamed al ejdaa was really helpful throughout the stay and also the other Mohammed who helped us on leaving and talking to us in his American accent. Rooms are as pictured

New property! As an experienced traveller, I love to explore new places all around the world and glad to be a part of AirBnb community. I feel so lucky for finding this place. Everything is new, full of art, nicely decorated and very clean here. It is located close to Nisantasi area and subway is literally 2 minute walk away. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They have 7/24 receptionist in the building which satisfied all my needs. They shared great tips for restaurants, cafes and shopping in walking distance. Also cleaning services are free which is great. Very soft towels, comfy pillows and a good night sleep . I can honestly tell you this place is perfect. Thank you all! I hope to see you soon!
Really nice, clean and comfortable place. Everything feels new and modern. Very helpful host with fast communication. Ideal place to stay. Highly recommended.

description: Enjoy a peaceful island stay surrounded by nature in the relaxing atmosphere of Büyükada. Featuring a shared pool, garden area, and comfortable living spaces, this home is perfect for both short getaways and longer stays. Conveniently located near restaurants, seaside walking paths, and the ferry port. Experience the calm and charm of authentic island life away from the crowds of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend this place. It is not as described and certainly it is not luxurious. Lots of things missing in the kitchen and the entire house and it is certainly not worth the price they are charging for it. Some of the basic things missing include: no iron, no ironing board, no toilet paper, not enough cups (only four for the entire house!), not enough cooking utensils, no extra towels (they offer access to a swimming pool), no clothes airer, no dishwasher powder, no washing powder, no refuse bins, no oil, no sugar. The list can go on for a while. I will stop here.
The place is finished to a poor standard (windows not closing properly, broken door handle) , the pool is shared with other three villas run by Büyükada Apart as well as the patio. So when you're outside on the patio having your dinner, people from the other villas walk through the patio to gain access to their properties or go to the swimming pool.
One of the mattresses had springs poking out of it and when we turned it around we found urine stains on it. Yuck! We obviously did not use it after that sight!
Overall, not a pleasant experience. They charge premium prices for a poor-quality product and service.

Clean house 15 minutes walk, about 5minutes up hill, from city center. House has a shared pool, across from a small playground, and is on the main hiking/biking pathway up the hill to the monastery, orphanage, and Luna Park restaurant. The hosts carried our bags, showed us around the house, and provided bath towels and hand soap. The spacious and clean house was very comfortable and great for a group of people. Be sure to get the white taxi number for home pickup; taxi and bus stand is behind the clock tower.

The place was great but the photos said there were a pool but it was not working.
Also the location u see on the map it’s not as same as the house location but they have transfer for ur baggages only for check in!
Beautiful and comfortable villa. Everything was clean, and the host was very helpful. Highly recommended!

description:
Cozy 2-bedroom Galata apartment with a living room, dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen. Features natural gas heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Styled in a local Galata home design, it offers charm and convenience. Located on the enterance floor, perfect for those seeking a central yet quiet retreat. Enjoy prompt assistance with our Superhost service. Ideal for a memorable stay in the heart of Istanbul!
Fast internet
6 min walk to Galata Tower, Galata Port, İstiklal

reviews.text:
We had a great stay. The location is central and ideal for exploring the city. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and felt like home quickly. The shower was excellent, and both heating and air conditioning were available.
Eyüp was an outstanding host. He responded quickly to every question, checked in regularly, and came immediately when the WiFi went out. He genuinely cares about his guests’ comfort.
There was some daytime construction noise nearby. It didn’t affect us since we were out most of the time. If you plan to work remotely from the apartment during the day, it may not be ideal.
The apartment sits at the top of a steep hill, typical for Istanbul. We walked down and took a taxi back at night, which was inexpensive and dropped us at the door.
Strong value for a prime location. I would stay here again.

We stayed with 3 people for 9 days and really enjoyed our stay. Check-in was easy, we came into a clean and comfortable place at night. Both Wi-Fi and air conditioning were perfect so we had no issues with working from home. The environment was safe as it’s very touristy and a lot of restaurants in the street you can try. Since it’s located near residential buildings we didn’t have a lot of issues with traffic noise. Also situated near the Galata Tower and Istiklal so we didn’t have to walk far, we only took the taxi 2 times but you can definitely walk to Hagia Sophia. Rooms are clean, and you also have a working washer so we didn’t have to stress about our clothes. We definitely recommend this place since it’s quite private, comfortable and close to a lot of tourist attractions. We’re definitely coming back.

We had a wonderful stay! The flat was exactly as described clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The location was convenient and made it easy to explore the area. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the check-in process smooth. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area. We’d be happy to stay here again!

Location was perfect for moving around the city, also close to bus to airport.
The place was comfortable and was fully equipped, also nice heating system. Finally, Eyo was an outstanding host; so helpful and attentive to every small detail, familiar and effective with the information.
We'd definitely recommend this place, also good valued.

We had a wonderful stay! The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, with plenty of restaurants, shops, transportation, and attractions nearby. Eyup was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. We truly enjoyed our time and would happily stay here again!

description:
I have 11 apartments where I can host my guests. If this apartment is not available on the dates you want, please check the other apartments in my profile. You can find all the reviews about me on my profile.

My apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street. Thus, bus, subway etc. located in Taksim Square. you can easily reach public transportation vehicles. It is also very close to Karaköy and Beşiktaş. You can shop from stores in the street and eat and drink in cafes and restaurants

reviews.text:
We stayed at this place for a week, and I want to list the pros and cons that we noticed below:
Pros:
1. It is close to Taksim Square (like 7 min walk)
2. Looks like the pictures.
3. It has AC, an elevator, washing machine, which were very helpful.
4. It had two cute cats, and they were coming to the window and asking for food. They are the mother of other cute kittens. (please consider feeding them if you choose this place :) )
Cons:
1. The whole place smells like smoking. They are cigarette spots on the couch.
2. They had a very rude lady neighbor living next to our house. After about 20min since we arrived at the house, she first punched the walls aggressively, then came to the door and told us we were loud in an insulting way.
3. The sink in the bathroom is super tiny. You can barely wash your hands.
4. I am not sure if the bed was clean or not. but my body had a rash reaction to it after one night of sleeping on that bed.

Spacious one bedroom apartment& very quiet, at the back of the building. For the price it was very good value. The hosts were very keen to help with any problems. There’s plenty of plus points: comfortable bed, large new fridge freezer , new gas hob, security. I personally wasn’t happy with the shower room but apparently major renovations in the building will take place next year. Soundproofing is minimal atm. The area feels safe but somewhat downmarket. But only 10 -15 minutes walk to Taksim square & metro& cafes& restaurants. Plenty of local supermarkets round the corner& quirky small independant shops. very good value for Istanbul. The Bosphorus is only 1 stop on a super modern train( not metro but underground) and only 30 minutes or so to Sultanahmet touristic area& Grand Bazaar& boat trips at Eminonu. My highlight was finding bbq mackerel on the quayside , walk under the bridge away from the obvious cruise boats……
Beware the city is 21 million population, & a major tourist hotspot

I wish i could have uploaded the pics I got. Anyway, overall I gave him a 3.
Great things: checkin experience and flexibility . To be honest that's the only reason I'm not giving a 2. The manager was very kind to let us check in early at 7am instead of 2pm. Thank you!
Good things: location is Cihangir with access to cafes, Istiklal, Karakoy, Galata, etc.
Bad things: walls which you can hear everything happening in other rooms! Dirty furniture with some smoking holes! Beddings in the lowest possible quality. Only one toilet paper for three people three nights!
Overall, i was disappointed and their kindness to let us check in early is the main reason I give three instead of two.
the place was really clean and had a lift which is great, same as the photos, nice and safe neighbourhood, close to restaurants, markets.

Great host, very helpful and instructive.
The house was clean and confortable, and looked exactly as in the photos.

description: I live in a quiet street called Kocamustafa Paşa Mahallesi, Pamukçu Sokak in Fatih, Istanbul. My home is in a central position and is close to transportation vehicles, SultanAhmet, Eminönü, Gülhane Park, Galata Tower. (about 4-5 km) My house is 1 bedroom and 1 living room. reviews.text:
The flat is located is a calm street and very close to Koca mustaphapaşa bus station which comes handy if you want to go to different places in Istanbul.
Mahmut is a very calm, respectful and helpful person, he's very responsive whenever you need him.

The apartment is located in Fatih, the old heart of Istanbul with an ancient history and its own flavor. It's close to the Marmara Sea, which makes the air fresher and cooler. And you can easily reach any other place in Istanbul, especially if you don't mind taking the bus instead of the metro or tram (their stops are farther).

Bedsheets are filled with cigarette burns all over and room is smelly . There were some kittens in the flat which it wasn’t mentioned in the description and I’m allergic to pets .
My stay was wonderful, the place is clean, the location is good, and Mahmut was always there to help.

Mahmut’s place was amazing, great person who helped me in my whole stay even made food for me. The Place was cosy and very clean. Had great stay, 100% will go back and stay there. Also in a great location.

description: This is a cozy private room with ensuite bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City. There are many places around where you can have dining including breakfast. Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.

reviews.text: Very nice and clean place situated in old Sultanahmet area very close to the main historical places. Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and all main museums are in the walking distance from this place. The room was exactly as it shown on the photos, clean and modern, beds were comfortable and cozy. The breakfast was made of traditional Turkish food and we got it on the roof terrace with amazing views on Sultanahmet mosque and the Sea of Marmara. Sunsets were also priceless over there. The staff was extremely friendly, we felt very welcome at the hosts place. All our questions were answered and all our requests like downloading our photos from camera card to our external hard drive disk were solved. We enjoyed our staying at this place and will definitely recommend it to all others. Next time our visiting Istanbul we will definitely consider to stay at this place!

Helpful & friendly staff. Listing was absolutely accurate. Safe neighborhood. The location is next to the Blue Mosque, 5 min walking distance. Excellent heating in rooms (in January). Very, very clean - bravo! Free mini bar with drinking water :)

Safe taxi service right outside the hotel. Print map, most of taxi drivers do not know the location. Hotel has a magnificent view from each room. Very good breakfast on the top floor overlooking the sea and the Blue Mosque.

Pros:
Responsive virtual host, Zeynap communicated well and was polite
Good location
Budget friendly
Cons:
No lift
Low ceilings in some rooms inc the shower (stayed in two different rooms during a split stay)
Noise - mainly from one particular member of staff during night shifts, who also tried to enter my room unannounced (not sure why)
Overall, felt safe as a solo female traveller, the place was a decent price and served its purpose. Would book again if I was on a tight budget

We had a wonderful first time visit to Istanbul with Deniz Houses Hotel! The hotel and apartments are in a series of next-door buildings, tucked into a quiet corner right below the Blue Mosque, and are within easy walking distance to the major Sultanahmet sites and metro stop. There were many cafes and restaurants nearby, and the whole area had a nice, safe, community feel to it - the atmosphere felt true to the old city district. We were given a lovely apartment-style room with living room, bedroom, and bathroom. The whole place had a beautiful, historic building feeling to it, with dark woods and rich carpets. The apartment was clean and spacious, the bathroom was great, the AC offered needed respite from the summer heat, and the fridge included free waters, teas, and coffees. The sea view from our balcony was lovely, and the view from the rooftop breakfast (hearty, diverse, and tasty options!) was even better - the Blue Mosque, towering right above! The staff provided maps and very helpful recommendations for touring, and also were able to help us arrange airport transfer. When we first arrived, the staff helped take our bags and then kindly gave us an overview of our location, some of the nearby sites and their history, and a few places further afield that we might want to check out. The wifi was a touch slow in the evening (when everyone else was logging on too!), but the staff were again very helpful in resetting and getting us back online. We had a marvelous stay and we're excited to come back some day!

Neighborhood in close proximity to all of the best sights in Istanbul, with a great view from the room. The room itself was very comfortable, very well kept and clean. The included breakfast on the rooftop was delicious and also was enjoyed with a great view. Definitely highly recommend this location, it is a great value with very welcoming hosts. The only thing is that this is more of a hotel than an airbnb apartment, but it is still definitely worth it.

description:

reviews.text: The apartment is quite clean and comfortable on the main street in the very center of Şişli, very close to the metro and osmanbey. host Alper and his assistant Ahmet are always ready to help you. recommend to anyone who wants to stay in the apartment

description:

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days. I think there are several units in this building that this groups manages (our unit was on the first floor). The place is modern and spacious and was outfitted with just about everything you would need (great air conditioning too). It was very clean but somehow the linens and sofa did not feel super clean. It didn’t help that the unit smelled heavily of cigarette smoke. The location is a bit of a mix. You’re just a 12-15min walk away from a famous shopping area, but to get there you have to cross a major street and be a bit brave (the pedestrian crossing isn’t respected by drivers) or walk an extra 5-6 min to the crossing that is more respected/has a light (sort of). You also need to walk through a neighborhood that until a few years ago was considered quite dangerous (this is also the view you see from the terrace). We didn’t feel unsafe keeping to main streets, but some people may. Our unit also had a bit of an insect invasion (must have killed 20+ earwigs during our stay).

The apartment was really modern, clean and cozy. The check-in and check-out process was super easy and the communication/response time was really quick. The apartment is located near Taksim and Istiklal Cd., so that you can get there by a walk. I would recommend the apartment and would stay there again! :)
Eeverything was exactly like the pictures. Very clean, good furniture and well equipped. The person in charge of the place was very helpful during the whole stay.
great value for money, good location. clean and tidy. just what you need for a good rest after a busy day
Very nice location, easy check in, friendly people at the reception. A bus station is near by an you can walk to the main shopping street. All in all very nice experience.

description:
In the heart of city. Located on Istiklal street. Close to Tunnel. This huge apartment has 6 bedrooms 3 full bathrooms and also 2 seperate wc. Has dining area and a working room. The passage that apartment is located has small cafes, restaurants and a famous second hand clothes shop.

A total living history…

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this apartment. It was exactly as pictured—beautifully decorated, spacious, bright, and impeccably maintained. The building has a charming vintage feel, and the elevator was a huge plus when travelling with luggage.
The kitchen was fully equipped with all the essentials, and most rooms had air conditioning, with fans also available for added comfort.
Emir was an exceptional host. He was highly responsive, monitored our flight schedule, arranged a smooth check-in with a representative at the property, and even organized a cleaning service during our stay.
The location is outstanding. Right in the heart of Beyoğlu, it's perfectly situated between Taksim Square and İstiklal Street, with easy access to Galata through the charming side streets. Overall, this was a true five-star Airbnb experience with a fantastic host, beautiful apartment, and unbeatable location. We would happily stay here again.

This is a fantastic apartment!! much better than what you see in the pictures. Six big bedrooms, comfortable beds, clean bedding, three full baths with an additional half-bath makes this place absolutely comfortable for big groups. The apartment is well equipped with anything you may need. Emir is a fantastic host. He quickly responded to our questions and helped us with anything we needed. The location is great, right in the middle of Istiklal street which is a busy street full of shops, restaurants, boutiques and in walking distance to the beautiful Galata Tower. Although the apartment is in city center and busiest part of the city, but it is located in a passage with entrance to Istiklal Street and is very quiet, no noise at all. You could also walk to the pier, it's about 15-20 minutes walk which you could then take the ferry to Istanbul's beautiful islands. We walked to Grand Bazar which took about 35-40 minutes. The train station is 5 minutes from this place which takes you anywhere you want. We all had absolutely great time in Emir's place and we highly recommend it! We hope to visit again!

Emir helped us when we were in a bind and had to find a large Airbnb to accommodate our family of 8 people (2 of whom were toddlers) at the last minute due to a situation with our previous Airbnb. We greatly appreciate this. However, the Airbnb smelled of curry, there were stains on the pillows, sofas, and towels (I couldn’t bear to look at the mattresses). The bathrooms/showers smelled of mold and many bath towels had holes (large tears) with the stains. This made it hard for us to get comfortable during our stay. And as a mom of toddlers, I was concerned of the cleanliness of the home. The location is central with shopping, a small grocery, and restaurants steps away, and we appreciated the lift/elevator. The design is urban with a lot of character - barreled ceilings & possibly original floors. Though my son got a splinter rolling around on the floor. All in all, cleanliness of the soft surfaces was terribly unsatisfactory and cast a dark shadow on what could been a good rental.

Emir’s place cannot be in a better location in Istiklal Avenue, surrounded by restaurants, cafes, and shops. We walk to all the main touristic attractions from this place.
The apartment is very spacious and the rooms are as described in the pictures. We were a family of 11 and had plenty space to feel comfortable. The only thing I wish is that there were more bedrooms with their own bathroom/shower. They is just one master room with its own full bathroom. The other bathrooms/showers are shared. But otherwise, it has everything we needed for our stay. Emir is a great host! Friendly and responsive! We enjoyed spending 5 days at his place.

I have booked this accomodation with another one of emirs air bnbs on the same floor in this building. In total we were a group of 16 people which was amazing for this flats together. Everyone had enough privacy and enough bathrooms.
Emir, was a very responsive host! I was able to reach him even at 1:30 am and he helped me immediately! I truly appreciate the flexible check in and check out times. Everything matched the pictures was very clean. Every room has an AC which made things much more comfortable.
The view is stunning towards the sea! And you don’t really hear a lot from the hectic street below
Close to amazing restaurants and bars-
Thank you emir!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was beautiful, clean, and comfortable, and everything was just perfect. The host was very kind, helpful, and welcoming throughout our stay. Thank you so much for your hospitality and for making our stay so enjoyable. We would definitely love to stay here again! 🤍✨

Very nice stay. Would come back. Stayed 5 nights as a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 young kids). Very spacious and modern duplex apartment. Clean on arrival and once we got the keyless entry working, the whole thing was very smooth. Apartment has amazing facilities downstairs with the pool and gym (there's also sauna and steam room but we did not check those out).
The area around the apartment is very basic - you can get basic amenities from the shops but no more. 20+ min walk to Taksim Square, which I would not recommend doing with buggies and/or late at night. So, you'll be reliant on Taxis/Car to get around, which was not a problem for us.

description:
Wifi internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nisantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
Wonderful host, communication was great, the place is lovely and clean. Building is awesome - gym, sauna, pool, yoga room.
Cons: location. It was hard to get food delivered or get to coffee shops and restaurants - it’s on a busy highway with nothing around, so you’d have to deal with pushy taxi drivers everyday and it’s not a nice experience.
If you have a car - it’ll be perfect.

Wohnen auf der Autobahn. Neben dem Zimmer an sich, der Einrichtung und Ausstattung, den freundlichen Hosts die immer schnell antworten und auch dem reibungslosen Check in, können wir diese Wohnung leider nicht weiterempfehlen. Sie befindet sich wie eine von vielen in einem
riesigen Gebäudekomplex, welches wie ein Hotel aufgebaut ist und liegt direkt an einer Autobahn/Hauptverkehrsstraße. Man hatte einfach nie Ruhe egal ob Tag oder Nacht. Wir sind nicht zur Ruhe gekommen und konnten durch den Lärm nicht schlafen. In der Lage Beschreibung war dieses Problem leider vorab nicht abzusehen. Also wer auf ständig hupende Autos, Polizei Sirenen und Dauerrauschen von fahrenden Autos steht, ist hier genau richtig. Auch die Lage an sich hat uns nicht zugesagt. Man ist zwar in 10 min schnell zu Fuß in Taksim, aber so ums Apartment drum herum gibt es nicht schönes. Keine netten Ecken mit Cafés oder ähnlichem wo man gerne sitzt.
Der Kontakt mit Duygu & Tevfik war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend, aber das bringt leider alles nichts, wenn man sich durch den Lärm dauergestresst fühlt. Daher leider keine Weiterempfehlung.
great apartment, small as shown in the pictures, no noise for neighboors. I can recommend.

Good location
Host are available all the time
Nice and clean apartment. Close to Taksim! thnx!

description:
The suite is located at the center of Florya. Supermarkets , restaurants , banks and lots of other stores are within 1min walking distance. Reception is at your service for your needs at BayMari Suites Florya. All Suites are renovated at November 2021

The apartment is ideal for both couples, families & big groups of up to 8 people.
