reviews.text: The suite was spacious and in a convenient location near markets and restaurants, but didn't look as nice as the pictures in Airbnb. Airbnb showed we received a significantly discounted price, but it was the regular price posted on wall in reception office. The receptionist and security guard were helpful with resolving issues during our stay. Parking is an issue with limited space. I had trouble driving van out with car blocking entrance. The TV in living room was replaced because of display issue. Power in kitchen went out twice and they helped reset the circuit breaker outside the suite. The electric panel cannot support running cooking on stove, baking in oven and boiling water in the electric kettle at the same time. We ran out of shower gel after a few days and had no trash bags, but they provided it when we asked. We got bitten by mosquitoes in the bedrooms. Fixtures in master bedroom need attention like loose toilet seat and loose shower door. Bed mattress was not comfortable.

Ece's place is a great apartment hotel with beautiful rooms and extremely friendly and helpful staff. There are many restaurants grocery stores nearby. WIFI is fast and reliable. Parking is easy. One of our best Airbnb experiences.

First and foremost, cleanliness is a top priority for me when traveling, and Baymari Suites absolutely nailed it. The suite was spotless, and I immediately felt comfortable and at ease.
One of the highlights of Baymari Suites is its unbeatable location. It's a stone's throw away from the beach, the Aqua Mall, and the Istanbul Aquarium, making it an ideal choice for beach lovers and anyone looking to explore the city's aquatic attractions.
Moreover, the convenience of having numerous stores and restaurants within walking distance was a huge plus. It made dining out and shopping a breeze, and I truly felt immersed in the local scene.
But what truly sets Baymari Suites apart is its outstanding staff. The reception team was incredibly friendly and helpful, always ready to provide recommendations and assistance. The security personnel also went above and beyond to ensure a safe and secure stay.

Everything was great except the showers.
While you are taking shower the water goes ice cold then it gets warm again and then back
To ice cold.
Also there was a bad smell in the entire house for the first day which they got rid off.
All in all the stay was nice but location is really far from all the big shopping centres.
Although there is a few near the suits, but it’s far from Taksim and the famous shopping centres .
I recommend staying there, just remember the showers

We had a very comfortable stay at Ece’s apartment. She is flexible with our check-in and the home looked exactly like the pictures. Though there were few minor issues with Internet and housekeeping activities, overall the stay was very good.

description: 1st-floor apartment home, fresh renovated and totally private - Not shared. Kitchen including basic utensils. Dining area with table seating for 10 Living room with sleeper sofa, chairs, end tables, flat-screen Smart TV, Bluetooth, and Wifi compatible. One full bath with shower, complete with toiletries and towels.

reviews.text: Mert was an excellent host. Very flexible with check in and departure times. Great location, in a quiet area and close to the tram. Large space and was well equipped. Air conditioning worked through the apartment which was great. Beds and pillows were okay. The only negative feedback is that the apartment wasn’t very clean. In saying this, the apartment was good value for money so if this isn’t important to you then this place is perfect.

Overall our stay was decent. The apartment is on the first floor - there are about twenty steps overall to get to the apartment, checking in was easy and Mert communicated very well with us throughout our trip.. the apartment is clean, however the shower tends to leak water through the shower so had to put a few towels on the floor after every shower. Unfortunately the washing machine turns off when the lights of the bathroom turn off which meant my clothes stopped in the machine mid cycle drenched in water overnight. Mert was good to sort it out the next morning . One of the bedroom contains a boiler which can be noisy at times.
The location is good - it’s close to Tophane tr station and 6 minutes away from Istiklal road ( but it’s a bit of steep climb getting there). Overall enjoyed our stay and our host Mert was lovely.

It was a nice stay. Apartments are in an amazing neighborhood, you can find plenty of cafes/restaurants/design shops and beautiful streets nearby. This location has a great transport infrastructure. The apartments were clean and nice with all you need to spend decent 10 days in Istanbul (with a great Wifi by the way). The host was very helpful and communication was great.
Although, there were several issues which I have to say about. First of all - the third room (the smallest) doesn't have real windows, it's the windows into another room (into something like a storage room). Second of all - the floor is cold and freezy in the common area (kitchen and living room).

The shower cabin was dirty and smelled bad. The couch also smelled bad because smoking is allowed in the apartment, and overall it smelled like cigarettes. The location and communication with the owner were okay.

We were a group of 6 adults and 2 kids. The place was perfect for us. The location was very good, 10 mins walking distance to Istiklal street and to Galata tower. Mert and Izel were very helpful and responsive all the time. There was issue with the shower, they sent someone to fix it within an hour. It was a very pleasant stay and we will definitely consider the place if we come back again as a group. Note: for elderly ppl, there is a stairs on the way to Istiklal street which might not be convenient to them.

description:
Classy furnished dublex residance for a family. Fiber internet, 30 Mbps speed. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
Area is terribly unsafe , industrial , far from everything and if you want to go to Taxim etc you are in a dangerous area anyway .
House is just dirty , mouldy , bed sheets not washed for ages to point that you can see stains and smell yuk.
Mould in shower …. Beds terrible , everything is cheap tried to look good!
I complained and what they did they said I have to leave ASAP . She emphasised ASAP !
Where would you go in midnight in a foreign country in such a suburb .
Just don’t trust these scammers .

Great stay. The place was spacious which is what we wanted. Good amenities inside the apartment. We had everything we need d to make it a home. Bathrooms were clean and beds were well maintained. Our apartment had a balcony so it was nice to be able to look over.
Close to the mosque so beautiful to hear the call to prayer. Several shops nearby for basic groceries but if your looking for a supermarket you’d need to walk a few minutes.
Communication was solid from Duygu and she was very responsive throughout the day. Finally - the hotel gym and facilities are also amazing!
Really well furnished and perfectly located flat, and our host was very accommodating and helpful. Would definitely recommend an we will be back in summer :D
Die Unterkunft war top, Check In ebenfalls unkompliziert. Die Kommunikation hat super geklappt. Leider muss ich aber das Internet / WLAN kritisieren. Im zweiten Stock hatte man keinen Empfang.

One suggestion wouldt be for an aircon In the second bedroom, we were 4 adults travelling together, so who gets the aircon.
The upstairs balconies could do with some chairs to really enjoy those spaces
Some artwork downstairs and a few scatter cushions will take your place from amazing to perfect

description:
Cozy apartment, 3 minutes away from Osmanbey metro station, 4 minutes from Nisantasi, and 8 minutes from Cevahir Mall.
International & sports TV channels.
high speed WiFi, elevator, balcony, Family friendly
3 minutes from Osmanbey Metro Station, 4 minutes from the brands street in Nisantasi, and 8 minutes from Cevahir Mall.
All Arab, international and sports channels.
High-speed Internet
Elevator
Balcony

reviews.text:
First let’s talk about Hessam and Mira. Most wonderful host and hostess ever. They we’re always available to help with any questions we had about places to eat or visit or how to get around even late at night.
The location is perfect for first time or many time visitor. It is only 4 minutes walk to nisantasi subway Osman bay was only one station from Taksim and about 10 minutes metro to grand bazar. Could not be better location for getting around. Street was quite so we slept well even though was so close to all action. Was wonderful.
Place was great for family of 6, very comfortable and clean with anything we needed for daily living. We cooked for one day for 14 people and had no problem.
I highly recommend their unit to anyone wants to relax and enjoy Istanbul.

perfect place!
very friendly hosts, they helped us with all issues, not even related to the apartment, they helped us pass the PCR!
the apartment is clean and very comfortable, I wanted to stay there forever! great location, close to metro!
Thank you to the owner and his lovely wife we ​​will definitely be back!

Hesham is a great host. The flight delayed and my parents arrived late at night, but he waited there for check-in. He is very helpful and kind and his wife too. The home was clean in a good area.
The home is near bus station and subway.
At night you feel peace in the area.
I really recommend this home.

Hisham is great. The apartment is amazing and sparkly clean. The location is central and nearby everything. Elevator is easy to use and spacious for bags. Nothing to complain about, the apartment is ideal and can easily fit 6 people.
Very clean and tidy apartment. Responsive and kind owner. We lived in the apartment for 5 days with great pleasure, it was very comfortable for 4 people

description:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to my home in the Kurtuluş district of Istanbul, the most convenient and safe district.
You are at an address where you can stay comfortably and reach everywhere easily. My house is on the 4th floor. It is only 10 minutes to Nişantaşı/Osmanbey, 3 minutes to Taksim Metro Station and 20 minutes to Istiklal Street.
A maximum of 2 people can stay in the apartment.

reviews.text:
Place perfectly corresponding to the description. Nice cute place near to metro in a nice street with some very nice bars, in an overall quite area. The place was super clean, really. I felt safer than in a hotel. Water was not powerful as there are some works still ongoing (istanbul issue and not host's) but I washed my hair without any problem and I have lots of hair. I'm writing this because according to another review it was a major issue. Come on, it did not affect my stay at all. Wifi: I've been working from there doing video calls (Teams and Zoom) with France. All perfect.
And Damla, the host, wonderful. Thanks for being so responsive and reactive. It's a real Airbnb, managed by real people and not by foreign companies, it's a place with its story, and Damla makes you feel at home. Hope to come again.

Damla was an amazing host , and very helpful. The place was the same as photos but if you are used to AC it will be very annoying to stay inside the home , very hot .
The area itself wasn’t that bad it’s actually calm and quiet

The reviews of other people are true. They agreed that they could check me in at 17.00-18.00, as a result, I stood on the street with a suitcase and waited until 21.00. Interestingly, when I wanted to leave at 15.00, she said that the Cleaning Lady would be at 12.00 and this is impossible. Double standarts. The bedroom smells of dog very strongly. The water flows in a thin stream, it is almost impossible to wash. The whole apartment is littered with things of the owners, there is practically nowhere to put your things. Slow Internet connection. Comfortable balcony.

It was wonderful to stay at Damla’s place, good location close from many nice local bars and restaurants. 10 min away from metro station. The apartment is well decorated and clean, It contains everything you need.
Damla was very friendly and helpful, I asked her if I can stay at the apartment for some hours after checkout deadline, she accepted that and was very supportive.
I recommend it to everyone :)

Ev sahibi çok yardımseverdi, tüm sorularıma hızla dönüş yaptı. Ev çok temizdi ve gereken her şeye sahipti. Konumı ise gerçekten çok iyi bir yerde Osmanbey metroya 4-5 dk yürüme mesafesinde. Market restorant gibi ihtiyaç duyduğumuz yerlere bir kaç dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde. Her şey için bir kez daha teşekkür ederim.

description:
King Suite-Premium Class Apartment
Our apartment is just perfect for romantic weekend or for those who wish to feel the perfect vibes with the only premium class apartment in the most central place in Istanbul.
The building has large elevator.Each apartment has new furniture with well equipped. We try to think everything for our guest comfort.
High class, comfy,, luxury,,,whatever you need by eRa Quality.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Jundo Apartment. The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything I needed was easily accessible. Jundo was a very responsive and helpful host, which made the stay even better. I truly enjoyed my time here and felt right at home. I highly recommend Jundo Apartment to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle free stay.

My wife and I stayed here for our trip to Istanbul and I have to say the thing that drew our attention the most is how similar the place looks to the photos.
The owner is very helpful and responds fast. The location is great, there is taxi a place very close with taxis that can take you to the airport.
The apartment itself is beautiful, clean and the view on the city is too.
We had a wonderful stay here and next time we are in Istanbul we will definitely try to stay in this Airbnb again.

The apartment is as per details in the advertisement. The flat is spacious and comfortable. It is great for couples. On 7th floor with city view, the building is clean with a lift.
The location is very close from Taksim square, and 3 minutes walk to Istiklal street. Nearby everything one May need.
Keyless access. Also, taxi stop is just in the corner; so no hassle to get taxi.
Noise from the cars on the main road.
I would highly recommend this listing.

I stayed here for two nights to have a romantic stay. The room was even better than the photos and description. The hosts were responsive and very thoughtful the entire time. It is the perfect walking distance location to Taksim Square where everything is... the restaurants, stores, and mosque.
This was an incredible stay, perfect hosting experience, and will book again and recommend it to others! Thank You!

The apartment was very nice and clean. The location was perfect, close to plenty of places to eat and explore. The host provided clear instructions which made check-in easy. They also responded quickly when needed. Overall, a comfortable and convenient stay.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place in Sisli . The studio is fully equipped with kitchen utencils; with a supermarket just around the corner. 7 mins walking distance to popular shopping district Nisantasi full of hip cafe&restaurants .Less than 5 minutes walking distance to Mecidiyekoy where is the public transport hub that connects any corner of the entire city. About 2kms away from Taksim Square the well known touristic area surrounded by restaurants and night clubs.

reviews.text:
Zeynep is a very kind and an amazing host. She took time to stop by to say hi to me and welcome me. This gesture of kindness meant a world to me. Also she was very responsive to any question and advice I needed.
The studio apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. Very clean, safe and located within walking distance from shops and restaurants, and shopping malls. Even though the apartment have fully equipped kitchen, with the restaurants and cafes nearby one would not need to worry preparing dinner or lunch. An excellent walk to Taksim Square (30 minutes). I would recommend walking to Takism Square for those who can since you will be passing by many many stores until you get there.
Tips: Do not exchange money at the airport unless you MUST to pay for things ti get here. You get better rates at currency exchange shops close by. Overall an excellent stay.

First of all Gizem is an excellent host. Every question I had she responded immediately. The apartment was very clean. The building is a new building. Kitchen and bathroom is modern, not like typical old Istanbul apartments. Location is excellent, walking distance to shops, metro station, cevhair mall, super markets, atm's. The only little negative thing I can think of is that the apartment is a little dark but with all other positive aspects it is not even worth mentioning about. It has it's own private heating which you can set the heat yourself, AC and endless hot water. All with natural gas.
I would definately stay there multiple times with no hasitation... Thank you Gizem

Gizem is very welcoming and brightly smiling person. It was nice and easy to communicate with her.
Check-in and check-out process was flawless and right on time.
The apartment is greatly located. Two metro lines are in a reach of a brief walk. I found groceries, tabaco shops and good coffee in 10-15 minutes of walking around.
The apartment is clean and comfortable. Had no issues living there. Basically, everything is as it is described.
Thank you a lot for your hospitality Gizem! :)

I lived in this apartment for two weeks. A wonderful apartment that has literally everything you need and even more: interesting books (really good selection of books on cooking and travel), TV with netflix and excellent stable internet connection.
Good location on a quiet street close to various Sisli restaurants and cafes, bus and metro stations. Couple of markets and a trade center are easily accessible by foot.
The apartment is located on the ground floor and this is perhaps the only thing that can create some discomfort: I worked remotely every day and I missed sunlight a bit.
Apart from this, this is a very pleasant and comfortable accommodation, and Gizem is a super host who is not only always in touch on any questions, but also a great person to talk to.
P. S. Oh, and the bed and pillows. I slept really well :)

The great stuff: the host is super friendly and helpful; the flat is clean, well-stocked, stylish, tasteful, well furnished, and spacious. The location is close to food, shops, metro, and a very nice park all with 20 minutes on foot. Plenty of pillows to choose from and comfy chairs and a couch for lounging during off hours. The host was super helpful when we ran into an issue with wifi and took a lot of time out of her day to help us.
But the flat is on the ground floor and has tinted windows (great for privacy during the day but not for letting in natural light). If you don't mind a dimmer setting, you'll be fine, but if you crave natural light it can be a bit sparse.
Ground floor also means being closer to the endless noise of the city. Heavier sleepers will be fine, but if you are more noise-sensitive, you may need to put up with the racket of motor scooters flying by day and night (and the oldest clunkiest garbage truck ever drives down the road every night). The entry door that other residents use also is pretty dang noisy and often woke us up when people went in or out.
Otherwise, a great flat and an all-star host!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Overall a lovely stay in a lovey apartment. Worked remotely for 1 month.
Pros:
- Amazing location in Moda, decently quiet street that connects to the lively central Moda streets
- Value for money
- Excellent host! Always available and eager to help or suggest local places that won’t try and rip you off
- Bedroom doesn’t face street, decent if you’re a lighter sleeper like me
- Good wifi in living room, not super fast but supports video calls (rare latency/issues)
- Kitchen has all of the necessary basics to cook with (no working microwave)
Cons:
- Shower head not mounted (handheld)
- Had to buy my own fan (it gets hot in the apartment in summer)
- Wifi doesn’t quite reach past the hallway (bedroom/sunroom connection bad)
- No change of sheets for bed (that I could find - should’ve asked though)
- Apartment generally slightly worn (normal for Istanbul)
- Had to go buy my own dishwashing liquid and toilet paper (cheap)
- Water temperature not consistent (cycles up and down)
- Only one pillow on bed (should’ve asked for more though)
Final notes:
Definitely would recommend! Don’t Google to find best/closest shops/places, just ask Taylan.

The Host was very responsive and flexible about the check-in. The location was great but the apartment needs maintenance as the Host should pay attention to some details regarding the comfort of the tourists when they arrive, for example: proper clean towels. The booking was made for 2 but he left only 1 towel (in a bad condition) and the bed hadn't bedsheet but only a small blanket. We had a great time in the city, we definitely recommend come to this area and some details must be improved by the host to be a great place in Kadikoy.

Taylan is one of the most corteous and understanding hosts I have come across so far. he was so nice to wait up for me when I had quite a delay during arrival.
There were some small issues (the mirror fell of the bathroom wall and broke :D) and Taylan was very quick to take care of it and replace it.
He also gave me extra towels besides the ones provided.
The kitchen is very well equipped which is a big plus. The enclosed balcony is supercozy to sit, esp. in the evening.
The house itself has a bit of a humidity issue, but in the apartment in summer that wasnt a problem.
The location is very close to the busy area of Kadiköy with the bars and cafes, yet quiet enough to get a good sleep. The street itself is a rather quiet side street that gets a little busy in the evenings only with people passing thru.
Also the park and ferry pier are just like 10-15min walk. super convenient to get anywhere, even if you need to commute to the European side every day. The ferry trip is very relaxing.
Metro and Marmaray are also superclose.
The location is excellent and the house was clean. only issue was despite being listed as self check-in, it was not.
Very good place , and friendly host , everything nice .and near the seaside,There have a lot club , if you wanna drink choice here , it’s a good decision

description:
“If you are interested in staying long term, I can give you a discount.”

Enjoy the cozy living room with a lot of sunlight. The living room have huge windows so you can chill and observe the city. In the back room the balcony looks at the hidden garden, so you chill, calm to sleep, read a book…

It’s perfect for remote workers, as wifi speed is incredible.

I have been living this neighborhood for a long time so I can share with you my favorite breakfasts places or anything else you need.

reviews.text:
Had a great time at Muhammed’s place! Stayed there for almost a month and by the end it started to feel like home in some ways. Lot’s of things stand out. The apartment is big enough yet still cozy. Mami keeps it clean. He gives you full access so you can make yourself comfortable in his space. The living room was my favorite corner of the house. There’s a huge TV with everything on it - Netflix, Disney+, Youtube, the whole package. The bathroom I found a bit small to my liking but it was kept clean so I didn’t mind. I didn’t use the kitchen as much except for the fridge so all good there. My room (the secondary bedroom) was satisfactory, a little low on lighting but that was okay. The bed was comfortable enough, there was enough storage space for my needs. The apartment also had an electric fan which was a huge help in the summer heat of Istanbul.
As for the location, couldn’t have found a better one! The apartment is 7-10 minutes of walk to the metro station which will literally take you anywhere on the Asian side and connect you to other metro lines that will take you anywhere on the european side of the city. It’s also like 5 minutes of walking uphill to the center of kadikoy. Lots of shops, restaurants, bars. It’s still secluded enough that there’s not a lot of noise. Then, the apartment is like 10 minutes of walking away from the main kadikoy ferry station which was a huge help. Also, 15 minutes of walking away is a big shopping mall (Tepe Nautilus). So you know, location’s great.
As for the host, mami is quite welcoming and friendly. He let’s you be and let’s you do your own thing while he does his own thing. He did have friends coming over from time to time but that wasn’t an issue for me personally.
All in all, I’d say great value for the price! A nice well-kept apartment. I’d recommend.

I had a great time at Mami's place - a harmonious combination of my own private room and being invited into the social life of my host. The location is great - not overwhelmingly central, yet very easily accessible to all that is nice in Kadikoy.
Mami is a great host, as he genuinely enjoys having guests at his house, especially internationals. At all times I felt welcome and included, that he cared about how I was doing and also I felt fully independent in the house. I especially appreciate the flexible check-in/out hours that didn't seem to bear any burden on him.
The apartment was always clean and organized, I had everything I needed, including the unexpected clean water and coffee, and even the occasional tea which he prepared for us.
Beyond all that, we also had great conversations, and so he was a friend at a time I needed it, as I travel solo.
Highly recommended if you're traveling alone and want to get the feeling of the unique part of Istanbul, Kadikoy.

I had a short but great stay. Mami showed me everything I needed to know when I checked in, and the apartment looks as good as it does in the pictures. We even had a tutorial on how to make a proper Turkish coffee, which I will always remember from now on. The area around the apartment is filled with bakeries, restaurants, many cafes and great little boutiques, and there are even more great places if you continue into Kadikoy. Transport options are also really good - you're near a rail station, a 15 minute walk to the metro and ferry port and there is also a massive bus station for local trips. I work from home and the wifi is always at a great speed. Overall, highly recommended. I was made to feel very welcome in this cozy place.

This was by far the best airbnb experience I've ever had. Mahmi (the host) embodies the spirit of Airbnb, which is more than just a place to stay but also a local friend. He treated me as if I were an old friend who had come to visit him from the beginning; he is a fantastic host and an amazing human being. I wish I could have stayed longer. Thank you for everything, man.
The bed is large and comfortable, and everything smells wonderful (kudos on your softener selection hahah) / The living room has natural light and a view of the street, which I value a lot as a Digital Nomad who spends several hours in front of a laptop, and it's nice to people-watch from time to time; in the living room there is an amazing sound system complemented by Mahmi's music taste, which is an epic win. Mahmi takes excellent care of his apartment and is constantly cleaning it.

Muhammed was an amazing host :) I felt so comfortable in his apartment. Mami is really nice and friendly person. We had such a lovely conversation together. Also when I needed my privacy it was really easy to have. Place is always clean. The location of the house is perfect. It is within walking distance to all public transport facilities. It is also very close to restaurants and bars. Highly recommended!!

description: Exquisite family suite in Sisli: Discover the charm of our renovated and lovely suite, a true gem nestled in the vibrant center of Sisli. With three bedrooms accommodating up to four guests, this cute apartment provides a peaceful space on a quiet and secure street, just a one-minute walk from the Osmanbey metro station. Relax in the comfort of a double bed and two single beds, ensuring a peaceful night's rest for your family.

reviews.text:
We spent 14 nights in Missy’s place and found it a nice base for exploring Istanbul. Everything matches the photos.
What we especially liked:
1. Location: A 5-minute walk to Osmanbey station. However, the street itself is narrow; taxis cannot park without blocking traffic, so you must have luggage ready before the car arrives.
2. Cleanliness: The flat was spotless on arrival.
3. Missy responsiveness and kindness: Missy replied to every message. She also provided both a baby cot and a high chair free of charge.
4. Two air-conditioners kept the main bedroom and living area cool; comfortable for sleeping!
* Points to consider
1. The wooden floor creak so loudly! Night visits to the toilet may disturb others. The single beds are also noisy when turning over.
2. The kitchen is perfect for light meals but it lacks oven with only a small fridge.
3. The studio is in the 2nd floor (~20 steps) with no lift. It is fine for healthy adults but carrying heavy bags or stroller requires some effort.

Overall a very clean and well-equipped place! The apartment was spotless, with fresh towels, clean bedsheets and all necessary kitchen appliances. The main bedroom was quiet and perfect for a peaceful night's sleep. The host was very responsive and always quick to reply, which was much appreciated. However, I had trouble sleeping in the smaller bedroom — the bed there made loud creaking noises whenever you moved, which affected my sleep for a couple of nights. Also, while it’s beyond the host’s control, the building’s main entrance door downstairs was often slammed by neighbors, causing the whole building to shake at times. It would be great if other residents were a bit more considerate.
Despite these issues, the host did a great job and the stay overall was comfortable. I'd still recommend the place, especially if you're planning to sleep in the main bedroom.

The flat was perfect location for us. Around the corner from Osmanbey station on the M2 so could get around easily to Taksim square or Fatih areas. Buses were easily accessible too. All the major coffee chains like Starbucks, Cafe Nero and Costa were in walking distance, although the local coffee shops were a minutes walk and perfect to people watch in and better quality coffee. G translate in all the local shops in the area will be your friend but that's not an issue. Plenty of high quality dessert shops to visit too. The flat was perfect with spacious rooms, washing machine, Netflix and AC for the hot weather. Missy was a super host and responsive to all our needs. Stay here if you want accessibility for being able to commute around on metros and buses but don't stay here if you are not prepared to mingle with all the locals and use G translate. The shops are also cheaper here, lovely busy bustling district and we loved it.

As an ex-Istanbuller, I can tell that the apartment is in a perfect location for visiting other neighborhoods and super clean apartments. The check-in process was pretty smooth, and Hots was helpful. I However, I'd like to leave a comment:
1- There was no Hot water for first day and next day until 15:00. After Long flight, it did not felt good not having a shower. Wifi is not stable. We contacted with host about issues but still, me and my party experienced this issues.
2-The bed frames are really uncomfortable and literally make noise every time you turn around while sleeping. We were not able to have a quality sleeping time. We tried to fix ourselves. Host offered a help but we were spending the most our times outside we did not wanted wait someone to come and fix it in middle of the day.

The apartment was in a very good location, right in the center and close to everything. Inside, it was almost exactly the same as the pictures, which was nice 👍.
Unfortunately, from the moment we arrived, we faced a big issue with the entrance. The external entrance to the apartment was dirty, with dog waste and a very strong smell, which gave a bad first impression.
We informed Missy, and she promised it would be cleaned, but unfortunately, nothing was done until the end of our stay.
Cons:
• Dirty external entrance
• Strong unpleasant smell
• No real response to cleaning request
Pros:
• Excellent location (central and convenient)
• Apartment looks almost the same as the photos

description:
Jun-Do Galata is located in the heart of Istanbul. Just few steps away to Galata Tower and Karaköy(Port).You can walk to Seaside in 5 minutes.The building has 8 airbnb apartments Each apartment has new furniture with well equipped. We try to think everything for our guest comfort.
The building is 3 minutes away to Galata Tower and 5 minutes away to Tram Station which goes to Historical Peninsula (Bluemosque,Hagia Sophia,Grand Bazaar).
Karaköy Ferry Station is only 10 minutes away ...

reviews.text:
The place was good, and the location was excellent—less than a 5-minute walk to Galata Tower. There were plenty of food spots and shops nearby, which made everything super convenient. The host was very responsive and quick to help with anything we needed.
The main downside was the bathroom. It was extremely small—the shower was right next to the toilet, which made it uncomfortable to use. Ventilation wasn’t great either inside the bathroom, and we often noticed a sewer smell coming from the drain.
The bathtub looked nice, but unfortunately, the drain didn’t close, so it couldn’t actually be used for a bath, just a shower. We also found an extra comforter in the closet, but it had what looked like a blood stain on it, which was pretty off-putting.
Overall 3/5 rating.

My stay here was great. We were 3 in total and the size of the apartment was big enough for the 3 of us. It looks like the pictures and was comfortable. The location is great. Just a few minutes walk to the tram and there are a lot of restaurant and bars nearby. It’s super easy to take the team north or south to the bazaar and mosques. The common room by the apartment entrance even has some umbrellas and has a small water dispenser in case you need water. There is also washing and drying machines if needed. The host was very kind and responsive and even helped arranged transport from the airport. We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment and really loved Istanbul. Definitely recommend!

Me and my friend arrived at the location at about 9.00pm.
After dropping our bags I noticed that the bathroom was not cleaned at all so I contacted the host which sent someone to barely wipe the surfaces whilst wew were out for dinner.
When we got back we wanted to shower but all the towels were just layingon a towel stand all rolled up wet and extremely dirty as nobody checked the place after the last guest left.
Pulled back the bed covers to find dirty sheets and pillows and the undersheets all wrinkled up as someone just slept in both beds.
when i contacted the host he was very dismissive and not a sign of apology for the dreadful state of the place.
when i metioned that i would not stay and look for something else the responce was appalling and we had to find somewhere else to stay at late night.
For the treatment that we got I won't reccomend at all.

Had a great stay. The apartment is in a good location close to Galatea Tower/Port. The host was very responsive as well. As other’s mentioned in their reviews, the apartment is very small, and the bathroom is so small that the shower is almost on top of the toilet. Overall, the unit was nice but not the most comfortable for two adults.

The communication with Ismail and his colleague Bhurat was great from the beginning till the end. The washing machine did not work upon our arrival but Bhurat came in no time and fixed it :) The location is good, unfortunatelly currently there is a construction site so it is possible you will not be able to sleep good at night as they might weld then. There was also strange smell coming from toilet. Finishings in the appartment could be done better. You can see the host is trying his best but we expected more value for money.

description: This spacious 3BR apartment offers a bright and relaxing stay in the heart of Cihangir. With two balconies perfect for morning coffee or evening air, the home provides generous light and comfort. The high-ceiling living room, stylish décor, and fully equipped kitchen create a warm, inviting atmosphere. Just a short walk from Taksim, cafés, boutiques, and transport links, it’s an ideal base for exploring Istanbul.

reviews.text: The house corresponds the photos. However, it needs lots of maintenance which makes your stay uncomfortable. The heating package does not work well and the water gets cold. The radiator in the living room and the bedroom beside it doesn't work. So, we used the electrical heater instead. When using toilet, there is water coming out from he lower parts. The second toilet is not well isolated and if it rains, there would be water all over toilet to the kitchen. The kitchen is not equipped with some tissue to dry or clean. Close to the city center, however, the neighborhood is not at all flat and not easy for old people. I asked him if there are any stairs because we travel with someone with knee issue and he didn't tell me there are some stairs and he told me the street is flat which was not totally true. You loudly hear neighbors late at night from the bedroom. The flat is not at all suitable for 7 persons. The dining room, kitchen, and living room are not big enough even for 6 people.

The apartment was very nice and clean. I a very cool neighborhood. Walkable to Istiklal street and Taksim Saquer.
The host was very communicative and nice and reacted very fast and brought anything we needed very fast.
Rooms, beds and kitchen were very clean. The bathroom had a little bit of bad smell and the water in the shower did went down quickly. We could also sometimes hear the neighbors. Otherwise it’s totally worth what we paid.
I recommend the place.

In the morning theres construction going on all day long, the noise is undescribable, and during the night the noise that comes from the neighbours seems as if they r living with us, the neighbours above us start running like crazy, and move stuff around at midnight, and the ones next to us like to talk all night long hearing their entire conversations.
The cleanliness of this place is not good, in the pictures on airbnb it looked clean, but on real life the kitchen and bathroom r a catastrophe, the kitchen is not fully equiped, the dish washer is too old to even function, and there is barely 5 cleaning tablets that exist under the sink,
The bathroom is full with flying insects, smells terrible, and the water is too hot for a couple of seconds then turn too cold suddenly, and smells like chlorix.
The bedrooms r the only gd thing about this place, but as i said u can hear through the walls.
The location is bad, u cant get any taxi easily, most of them get stuck on the closed road.

The apartment is on a hill-at 1 floor below ground floor but not a basement. It is close to Istiklal street and supermarkets. Although the location is very convenient for young people, it doesn’t work for elderly (steep streets). Hailing taxis using online apps was even hard. Inside the house looks good and bedrooms had clean sheets. The flooring was old and walking on them in the bedrooms made a lot of noise. Also, you could hear people walking or talking from the neighbors and their noise sometimes kept going till 3 am.
The bathroom needed renovations and water heater was not working properly. Even after their handyman came to fix and replace a part, the water temperature fluctuated so much that made taking a shower very inconvenient. Washing machine was not working either and when the handyman checked it, he found clogs which he fixed. Enis was responsive but we spent time troubleshooting these machines on the phone during the first few days and the water heater was a big problem.

The stay here was good with various attractions nearby within a walkable distance. The apartment was also clean with all required facilities available.
Only downside was the loud noises of furniture being moved upstairs throughout the night and upstairs neighbours making very loud noises which even involved screaming and shouting waking us up in the middle of the night.
This may not be directly the fault of the host but it did affect our experience. So, for anyone possibly wanting to stay here may need to take this into consideration.

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family. Offering hotel facilities in the Şişli area; comfortable, safe, next to the subway, within walking distance to Taksim, 3 minutes walk to Nişantaşı, clean, apartment with the comfort of your home,
available for rent immediately. We can't wait to welcome you to our new business.

reviews.text:
When we arrived there, we were disappointed and immediately wrote that we wanted to leave and get our money back minus the first day. But we were refused.
The apartment is very small and everything in it is of poor quality. Very cramped. Often smelled of smoke (but then stopped).
The Internet was disgusting, and even when they brought us a personal router, it didn't work. The speed dropped to 30kB.
There is a very noisy road right under the windows, scooters make noise and cars honk all day long.
Sometimes the alarm went off in the store 2 houses away and worked all night.
We asked to call the police, and they told us that no one had complained before us.
There is no work place either.
But it is indicated!
We reported this, and they offered us to work in the entrance next to the elevator. They put 3 iron bar stools next to one socket.
And this is in winter.
We lived here for a month and these apartments are not worth even half the money they ask for them. But if you need 2-3 days,

Burak responsive and clear. Easy instructions. Greatest benefit is the location. Area walkable and many shops and restaurants. Airbnb unit clean and neat. Just it is smaller then how it looks in the photos. 3 can sleep but my recommendation is for 2. I recommend Burak and this Airbnb.
Perfect location, easy to check in. Everything was as described and very clean. Will be staying again and recommending to my friends that travel to Istanbul.

I had a great stay at this apartment — it was very clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location is perfect, just a short walk from the metro station, which made getting around really easy. The apartment is on the 5th floor, and the elevator only goes up to the 4th, so you’ll need to take one flight of stairs. The elevator also got stuck a couple of times, so that’s something to keep in mind. I sometimes heard a door slamming noise from outside the apartment. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would recommend this place.

Excellent location in Sisli, close to Lotus Walk and City's Nisantasi. Lots of restaurants close by, and the apartment is right next to Osmanbey station, so it's easy to get everywhere. The bed is really comfortable and it's great to have a washer and dryer. Tamara is super kind and very responsive and was a real pleasure to deal with!
As mentioned in other reviews, the apartment is on a busy street, and it can be quite loud during the day and night. A big semi-truck parked on the street at 10:30pm and unloaded boxes until 2:30am. While the Airbnb owners can't prevent noise, light sleepers should be aware of the problem. The kitchen supplies were limited with just enough to cook with

description:
Our historic 4.5-story apartment is located on one of the most beautiful streets of the Historic Peninsula. There is also a small terrace in our building. We are within a 10-minute walk from the Sultanahmet Mosque. Our room is 19
m² and has air conditioning, a double bed, kettle, wardrobe, private bathroom/toilet.

Important Note: We cannot accept unmarried couples.

reviews.text:
This place is good for short term stay, definitely not for long term stay. If you want to work remotely, this is not an option.
While this is in great location with restaurants and water closeby, I would give this place 3 out of 5 stars. I am taking 2 stars out because of the following reasons.
(1) The internet was very poor at nights, like 10 Mbps. When I complained, the response I got was, because everyone is using, its slow and there is nothing that can be done. I book Airbnbs and not hotels for exactly this reason, I get my own wifi which is fast enough, not something which is shared with several other rooms. Well, then get very high speed internet if its being shared or have more wifi routers.
(2) The shower head was weird/broken. The water was warm, not hot. The bathroom was always cold.
(3) I was smelling cigarettes while walking inside the building till I enter room. Probably this is everywhere in Turkey where people smoke a lot

Initially, we booked this place for 2 days, but we ended up staying there for the rest of the trip because of how gorgeous the place was. The airbnb was nice, spacious, and clean. It had air conditioning, heating, and all other emmenidies were in walking distance. The location of the airbnb was great because it was 10 min from the Grande Bazar and 15 from the musjid Eya-sofia. Additionally, when we were leaving the place, our host booked us a Mercedes to the airport for a great price. Overall, this place was great, I would recommend this and it's perfect for couples. Also, if we had any problems or texted him, he would answer immediately. I will definitely be booking with this host again.

Biraz küçüktü ama iş görüyordu. Gayet temiz ve işlevseldi. Banyosu güzeldi. Zaten sadece konaklama için tutmuştum. Benim için yatak ve banyo önemliydi. Bunların konforu gayet iyiydi. Görevli arkadaş Mustafa da gayet ilgiliydi. Fiyatı ve konumunu düşününce kalmaya değer bir yer.

the hotel is in a great location. you can walk to the bazaar and Hagia Sophia within 10-20 minutes. Mustafa was super helpful in arranging a ride from the airport and staying up very late at night for my arrival. 10/10 would recommend for travelers on a budget.

The accommodation is very good for this money.
The room is small, but very clean and usually you could get the access to the terrace on the top floor. Air condition was working well so it was never stuffy in apartment. However, sound isolation was absent and you easily could hear all the people talking on the stairs.
Recommended for a short term stay.

description: Fully equipped 20 sqm studio located in a Condominium with elevators, security and concierge in central Nisantasi. The flat has a pull down bed for single travelers, bathroom, work place and a kitchenette including microwave, washing machine, fridge etc. The Condominium is located on the main Street of upscale Nisantasi neighborhood with a nice garden view and free underground parking lot. The place is bright, quiet and cozy. You’ll have 100 mbps high speed internet, TV, A/C and central heating.

reviews.text:
I stayed in Keran's apartment for 10 days. It's a cute studio in Nisantasi, which is a very nice and safe neighborhood. Restaurants, bakeries, cafeterias, a shopping mall, grocery stores and Osmanbey Metro Station are in walking distance.
The apartment is in a complex of quiet residential buildings with 24/7 security. Overlooks a beautiful patio with trees, grass and a small pool. The apartment is spacious enough for a studio, you have hot water at all times and has the amenities that one person needs. It is clean and internet is free and fast. The only disadvantage: there is no separate space for the shower.
Keran is a superhost which trust me, is super important. Keran has a lovely personality. He is polite, he has excellent communication skils, and he is extremely helpful. As a bonus....he speaks English, in a city where most of its inhabitants don't.
To sum it up, Keran and his studio are highly recommended for your stay in Istanbul

I had a great week staying at Kerem's place. Despite looking small in the photos the apartment feels pretty spacious. There were all the necessities I needed. The bed is very comfortable. The Wi-Fi is fast.
The location is also very convenient. 10-minute walk to Osmanbey metro station and multiple bus stops. There are a lot of restaurants and coffee shops nearby, as well as MM Migros.
Special thanks to Kerem for being an awesome host, guiding me on my way from the airport, and transferring me to the airport on my way back.

This place is great for one person and it’s located at a nice neighborhood in Istanbul.
Having a small kitchen and a washing machine makes you needless to restaurants and laundries.
You need only 15 minutes walking to get to American Hospital.
You will have a self check-in and self check-out with a clear instruction from the owner.
I was so comfortable at this place and recommend it to solo travelers.

The location is less than ideal, in a remote place far from the airport. It is quite difficult to locate also. AC is old and hence the place is quite hot in summer. There was also hair on the mattress, which is small and uncomfortable. There are better options for the price.

This is a nice spot in Nişantaşı. Definitely a very safe part of Istanbul that will feel very comfortable for visitors, especially with 24 hour security in the building. The apartment is quiet and peaceful and overlooks a nice courtyard. It's as pictured, and Kerem is a great host, always quick to respond. It's great for one person for short stays.

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 52 m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text: Öncelikle suite girene kadar problem yoktu ancak ev içinde çok fazla kadın saçı vardı üstelik yemek tencereleri yıkanmadan dolabın içine konulmuştu biz kendi imkanımızla başkasının kirini mecbur kalıp yıkadık üstelik banyo kirliydi pas pasın üzerinde sigara külleri vardı Tv nin interneti sürekli koptu ve donma yaşandı youtube üzerinden terbiyesizce (kanal ismi) oturum açılmıştı hoş değildi biz çıkış yapmak istedik. Yerel Kanallar olmadığı için giriş yaptık. Daha önce kaldığımız daire çok iyiydi en azından böyle sorun olmamıştı koltuk yastıkları silinmemiş ve yıkanmamıştı önceki kalan kişilerin salyası kuruyup leke olmuştu ve rahatsız ediciydi tam bir hayal kırıklığı yaşadık başka bir yere gitmeye kalktık gidemedik çünkü son paramızı güvenerek o suiti tutmuştuk.

7 gece 8 gün konakladım sıcak su hiç yoktu. Arıza var diye oyaladılar. Yatak saç ve kıl doluydu. Havlular nevresimler kirli ve lekeliydi. Duşakabinin içinde başkasına ait kişisel bakım ürünü vardı. Bina sakinlerini söylemek bile istemiyorum… sıcak suyun olmamasıyla alakalı nr bir özür ne bir ücret iadesi hiçbirşey olmadı.

My second time staying here. First time was great and flawless! But this time ran into a few issues. The power went out for hours. The hot water was working for 5 days and was told it will be fixed but never was. Contacted host but didn’t get much of a response besides it will be fixed and the run around.

Son derece iyiydi. Sevgilimle keyif alarak ferah ve huzurlu, sakin bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Tek sıkıntı duş kabini biraz sızdırıyordu ve havlular 5 günlük konaklama için yetersizdi. Haricinde otopark, ulaşım, güvenlik ve giriş-çıkışlar çok pratik olduğundan kafamız rahat bir konaklama yaptık.
I enjoyed my time in Amal’s apartment. The only problem is Esenyurt is not good enough to stay. But it is okay 👍 Flat was clean and comfortable

description: Ground floor, separated entry flat very close to galata tower, istiklal street and sishane metro station (2-4 minutes by walking). The place is located on very quiet and central district, you can find all you need in this small apartment. The entrance is totally separated so there is no any stairs. The flat is well equipped and there is an AC for heating and cooling. Please reach me out if you have any further questions :)

reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at this studio in Istanbul. Berk is a super host who really cares about his guests and their experience. He was very flexible and kind to let us check in early, since we had luggage with us and wanted to drop it off. He gave us a warm welcome and a thorough tour of the studio, explaining how everything works and where to find what we need. He was very thoughtful and attentive to the details that make a difference.
Berk was always easy to communicate with and very responsive. When we had an issue with the shower head falling off, he fixed it the next day without any hassle. He was very professional and courteous.
The studio itself is cozy and clean, just as described in the listing. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay, from a well-equipped kitchen to a cozy bed. The location is also great.
We would love to come back again. Thank you for making our stay in Istanbul so memorable and enjoyable!

I've recently stayed at this Airbnb and I must say, it was a wonderful experience. The location was perfect, with easy access to public transportation and plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. The apartment was very clean and well-maintained, with all the amenities I needed for my stay.
But what really stood out to me was the hospitality of the host. Berk was very responsive and accommodating, always willing to answer any questions and ensure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable.
I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay near Galata Tower (just 2 minutes from the apt). The combination of location, cleanliness, and attentive host make it an ideal choice for travellers. And with such a reasonable price, it truly is an excellent value for the quality of the experience.

Great friendly host, good recommendation for places to eat .location was amazing so close to many tourist spots, mostly walking distances. Apartment was clean, comfortable and simple decoration. For the price, it is excellent choice to stay here. Convenient location, comfortable accommodation and friendly host. Highly recommended

We booked this apartment on short notice and appreciated that the host reacted quickly and accepted our booking. The location is central and close to Galata Tower, but the steep uphill streets made it difficult to get around—especially with my pregnant wife—so we often had to rely on taxis.
Unfortunately, the apartment didn’t meet our expectations. It felt more like a garage than a proper living space. The front door wasn’t insulated, and we could hear everything from the street, including garbage collection at all hours—even during the night—which made it very hard to sleep.
The bathroom was in poor condition, with visible mold in the shower. The overall humidity in the apartment was terrible, and with cold weather and no proper heating (just a dusty, noisy AC that didn’t warm the place well), we both ended up sick by the end of our stay.
The kitchen was extremely small, poorly equipped, and lacked ventilation. The loud fridge also made sleeping difficult, as the noise carried dire

I really liked the location of this apartment - it's a short, picturesque cul-de-sac, and right next to the streets around Galata Tower. The front door is right on the street so easy access, no stairs. The interior has nice loft vibes, with an excellent mattress for sleeping.
The host was there to greet me in person, and was helpful and communicated well the entire time. 5 stars!

description: Great location on a quiet street in the heart of the European part of Istanbul. Brand new apartments that have everything you need for a great vacation. Cafes, stores are within a minute's reach. Istiklal is only 5 mins. Distance to Taksim metro station is 7 mins walk. So you can get to any part of the city quickly and comfortably. The main sightseeing platform of Istanbul - Galata Tower - is within a 20 mins. You can enjoy all the flavor and atmosphere of Istanbul if you stay with us.

reviews.text:
A very, very pleasant stay in Istanbul thanks to Ana and her excellent apartment!
The apartment is located in the heart of the Taksim. It is 5 minutes of walking distance away from the Taksim Square and the closest metro station, 10 minutes from the nearest tram station and the coast. The place is surprisingly quiet at peaceful both during day and the night.
The apartment itself is better than it looks in the photos!
Sparkling clean, spacious and with high quality amenities--all you need for a short or long stay. Big personal plus goes to having two ACs; one in the living room and another in bedroom.
Ana, the (co)host, was very responsive to our inquiries. She welcomed us kindly upon arrival and was available at all times from then on.
I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to have a comfortable and pleasant stay in Istanbul.
If the road takes me to Istanbul sometimes in the future, I will definitely repeat the stay here!

I recently booked an apartment in the center of Istanbul and was extremely satisfied with my experience. The location was perfect - it was within walking distance to many of the city's top attractions and had a wide variety of restaurants and shops nearby. The apartment itself was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The check-in process was smooth and the host was very responsive to any questions or concerns I had. Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this apartment to others.

Overall super pleasant experience. The location is one of the best in my opinion: lots of cafes, stores and different public transportation just in a walking distance. But during the night it's super quiet, despite being near the Taksim square. The apartment is in the freshly build building, stylish and clean. Would come back again for sure.

Nice and safe apartment in a really nice area.
Lots of local cafes, bars and restaurants. Not a touristic area but close to get to the spots to visit.
I had to work during the day and the Wi-Fi connection was great.

the appartment is modern and new.like a real suite.
we enjoy being there.
the host took care that we will satisfied

description:
Welcome to your stylish retreat in the heart of Galata, where history and modern comfort come together.

Located on one of Istanbul's most charming streets, the apartment is surrounded by art galleries, cafés, restaurants, and historic shops.

Set in a beautifully preserved historic building, it offers an authentic Galata experience.

Just 1 minute from Galata Tower, 3 minutes from the metro, and 10 minutes from Galataport, it's the perfect base for exploring Istanbul on foot.

reviews.text:
Alex’s super clean and charming apartment is in the best possible location in Istanbul, right by Galata Tower. If you’re seeking clean, comfortable, walkable charm and tons
to do nearby, this will work really well. Alex is a super host and met us, helped with luggage, and even provided an Istanbul Kart (so appreciated!). Clean apt, very spacious with two bedrooms, comfy beds and good pillows, and two full bathrooms with showers with good water pressure. There was a slight odor from drains, as other reviews mentioned, but cleared out by opening all windows. It’s a very old building. Apt is up two flights (no lift), so may not be suitable for those with mobility issues. We loved our weeklong stay and highly recommend.

- great location, close to lots of cafes, 15 minute walk to Spice Market, 40 minutes to Hagia Sophia.
- very quiet, we heard hardly any noise after 9pm
- comfortable queen size beds and nice to have dressers in the bedrooms.
- very cool decorating with old wood floors doors and trim, and brick walls.
- nice to have soap and shampoo in the showers, salt, tea, sugar, dishwasher soap, and washer soap all provided.
- excellent communication with Alex, he responded right away to any questions we had.
- the kitchen was reasonably stocked for us, though more pots, knives and a larger cutting board would probably be good for someone who did more cooking.
- some of the tiles and grout in the main shower need repair/cleaning.
We would definitely stay here again!

Fantastic Stay Near Galata Tower!
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment, which is just a few steps from Galata Tower—an unbeatable location! The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and perfect for our family, with two comfortable rooms and a spacious living room where we could relax and enjoy Netflix.
Alex was an amazing host—very responsive and kind. He even helped us carry our heavy luggage up to the apartment, which is on the second floor without an elevator. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed, making our stay even more convenient.
One of the best features was the washing machine and the dryer. The dryer worked exceptionally well, drying all our clothes in just an hour!
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thanks again, Alex!

We had a wonderful stay at Alex's place in Turkey, and honestly everything was perfect from start to finish. Check-in was easy, the apartment was spotlessly clean and exactly as described in the listing, and the location was excellent. Alex was a kind and welcoming host who communicated quickly and clearly and made sure we had everything we needed. Great value for the money too. There is truly nothing I could complain about. I would happily stay here again and warmly recommend Alex's place to anyone visiting. Thank you, Alex!

We stayed at Alex’s apartment from March 29 to April 5 and had an amazing experience. Despite our late arrival (11 PM), Alex warmly welcomed us, showed us around, handed us the keys, and made sure we had Wi-Fi access. The apartment is in a fantastic location near Galata Tower, close to restaurants, shops, and supermarkets. The neighborhood is safe, clean, and charming. We loved the rooftop bar next door with stunning views and the quirky Cat Museum nearby. The apartment felt like home—both king-sized beds were super comfortable, the kitchen was well-equipped (loved the two cafetières!), and the showers had great water pressure. We especially enjoyed relaxing in the cozy living room. Alex was an exceptional host—thoughtful, kind, and full of great local recommendations. He even offered help with bookings if we needed a translator. We’re so happy with our stay and will be recommending his place to everyone!

description: You can comfortably stay in this wonderful place with your whole family and friends. Duplex apartment with terrace and sea view, 15 minutes from Sabiha Gökçen Airport, within walking distance of Pendik Metro and Marmaray.

reviews.text: The house was clean and comfortable, second floor with the huge balcony was a plus. The view was extremely beautiful. It is located near the metro station and on the side of one of the main road. Vasfiye was very kind, flexible, responsive, and helpful.

The house was amazing. Exceeded expectations. Over two floors with lots of nice areas, multiple sitting rooms, bedrooms and bathrooms and views..we were only 4 but would have accommodated a party of 8 very confortably. Our host was super helpful with suggestsions for visiting islands/beaches, local restaurants and helping us get cheaper transfers to Sabiha Gökçen airport. Will definetely reccomendation to friends and book again

A good-looking place with a lot of room to hang out. Not the most comfortable, but generally nice. Great view from the terrace and balcony. Worth the price. The upper floor's toilet is not the cleanest, and the seat was broken, but there are two more toilets to use, so it was not much of a problem.

Metroya yakın ve şehrin içine kolayca ulaşılabilir noktada, temiz, büyük ve ihtiyaçlara yeterli bir ev. Ev sahibi oldukça hızlı iletişim kurmaktadır.
Teşekkürler

Kalabalık arkadaş grubu olarak tercih ettiğimiz evden genel olarak memnun kaldık. Vakit geçirmesi keyifli bir ev. Vasfiye Hanım sorularımıza hemen yanıt verdi, iletişimi iyiydi. Görsel ve ev tutarlıydı. Giriş yaparken ya da çıkışta bir sorun yaşamadık. Markete yakın olması da işimizi kolaylaştırdı. Sadece ev çok iyi temizlenmemiş ve tozluydu. Temizliğe pek özen gösterilmemiş gibiydi. Etraf toplu ve düzenliydi. Özetle memnun kaldık ve her şey için teşekkür ederiz :)

description:
We are adjacent to all important structures in the historical peninsula Sultanahmet region.
The basilica cistern is adjacent to us, and the Hagia Sophia mosque is in front of us. Topkapi Palace, Hippodrome Square, Islamic Museum, German Fountain, Indoor Bazaar, Corn Bazaar, Rose Park is 5-10 minutes walking distance.

reviews.text:
The hotel has two great plus: the location and the staff. we were a family with a small baby and it was great to have all the interest points nearby and all the tram/taxi/metro in a walking distance. Also there is a plenty of choice in restaurants around. The breakfast is very good too and the lady who makes the tea and coffe is lovely.
We manage to drop the bags earlier and then check in a bit earlier too. Thanks to the staff.
A special mention to Muzzafer who always had a gentle smile and was very helpful with any questions we had.
We found the room a bit small as we stayed for a week, and AC was very close to us, but manageable. The rooms were clean every two days -because we stayed over 3 days- and towels always replaced. We've noticed a bit of smell in the pipes, but we assume is an old building, didn't stop us to stay all week :)
Once again thanks to the amazing staff, you made our stay very pleasant. and thanks to amuze our little one :)

The location of this place was great and was surprisingly quiet for being on such a busy road and next to a tram line. We could see Hagia Sofia from our room window. The host was very kind and helpful and the breakfast downstairs was so convenient with lots of options. The only things that could have been better were the toilet (too small and the seat was too far back) and the bed was not comfortable at all. It was clean and simple, had all we needed. It was perfect for our long weekend trip to Istanbul. I would recommend.

Great location and affordable.
Took an UBER from the airport, cost TRY 1,279.85. Airport airport offered by the hotel was EUR 55. Airbnb listing stated that a taxi would cost TRY 500-600. Took a taxi from the hotel to the airport and I think it was around TRY 900. Note that taxis are unable to stop directly at the hotel as there are no public roads along it.
Pros
Friendly owners, room was cleaned daily. Breakfast with some variation and lovely area. Hotel is walkable to major attractions.
Cons
Smart TV did not work. They repeatedly said they’ll fix it the following day, but never did. Hotel is located next to the tram line, so you can hear the tram going by late into the night. On Friday morning 6 am, you’ll hear the morning prayer. Not a 5 star hotel but decent enough! Bed is two twin beds placed together.
Would highly recommend for fuss free travelers, great value.

Mustafa & Muzafe took great care of us, they are incredibly helpful and a comfortable presence to be around. The restaurant attached to the hotel has a cool atmosphere with traditional Turkish decor and we were happy our room had air conditioning.
The hotel is in a safe area of town, walking distance to sights, shopping and restaurants. We walked around each night without a problem.

Amazing location and great value for the price. Check-in was seamless, the owner and the staff were incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming throughout the stay. While the property has an older charm, it was comfortable and had what you needed. Overall, a really pleasant experience and I’d happily stay here again.

description:
*Air conditioning was installed at the request of the guests*

If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family.
10 min walking distance to Feneryolu Marmaray and metrobus
10 minutes on foot to Kalamis Beach
A side street of the minibus avenue
15 minutes walk to Kadikoy Square
Ground floor apartment on a quiet street with shopping places around

reviews.text:
Our host was attentive, helpful, and prompt whenever we reached out to him.
The apartment and the building both felt very safe and secure.
The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable.
The place was very clean and smelled lovely when we got in.
The location of the building not only makes it super convenient to get around in Istanbul, it's also mere minutes walk away from markets, hairdressers, and a wonderful bakery.
The apartment was very comfortable and had pretty much everything we needed, from a toaster to an iron, to all the cleaning supplies etc.
Despite not being a huge place, it was definitely big enough for 2-3 people. All the furniture was thoughtfully chosen to have plenty of extra storage.
One thing to note is that the shower is a half-sized bathtub that you can stand up in to shower easily, but not where you can take a bath.
All that said, we are definitely glad to have picked this place.

Haftasonu İstanbul kaçamağımız için çok güzel bir tercih oldu. Ev 3 kişi için oldukça yeterliydi çok rahat konakladık. Ev aynı fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi ilanda yazılan her şey de evde mevcuttu. Konumu itibariyle Kadıköy’de aklınıza gelebilecek her yere yürüyerek rahatça ulaşabildik 15-20dk civarı yürümeyle Moda’ya vardık. Kalamış sahil ise daha yakın 5dk mesafede. Toplu taşımaya da metrobüs/marmaray gibi yine 15dk yürüyerek ulaşabildik. Ev sahibi Yiğit bey de çok canayakındı vardığımızda evin önünde karşıladı bizi çıkarken de sözleştiğimiz vakitte ordaydı. Özetle çok memnun kaldık hem konumu hem evin yeterliliği olarak herkese tavsiye ediyoruz👌🏻

I and my friend stayed for two weeks and we had everything we need for quite a comfortable staying. Nearby are incredible! The apartment locates in a very good district of Istanbul: it's sumuntainiusly quiet, clean and easy going to famous sightseeing.
The only one thing that a little bit strained us — it was really very hot in the apartment and we couldn't cool down ))
Quiet place, very comfortable. We stayed almost 2 months. It has everything you need for a short or long stay. The host was friendly. He always helped us when we needed it. I recommended!

this is a great place to stay for medium and long trips. apartment is easy to find and very comfortable has a full kitchen and all the amenities
I would definitely recommend this place to people visiting Istanbul

description:
Unique Space near the Golden Horn!

☞ Walk Score 60 (Walk to cafes, dining, shopping etc.)
☞ 1000 Mbps wifi + workspace
☞ AC + radiant heating
☞ Kettle
☞ 32” HD TV
☞ Outdoor dining area
☞ Free street parking
☞ Upright piano

20 mins → DT İstanbul
30 mins → Istanbul Airport ✈

reviews.text:
This place is located inside the old city walls on a higher spot, with a fantastic view! The room has lots of windows, making it very bright, and the scenery looks just like a postcard. The room is clean, and the surroundings are quiet. Self check-in is very convenient, and the internet speed is fast. The host is friendly and replies quickly. The host mentioned there might be “construction noise” during the day, but in reality, it was just the occasional clinking sound of wood being tapped—nothing compared to construction noise in China, hardly worth mentioning. The only thing is the call to prayer from the mosque around 5 a.m., which is a bit loud and can wake you up, though it’s easy to fall back asleep. Public transportation nearby is also very convenient, with buses, trams, and the ferry terminal all within a few minutes’ walk.
Overall, we had a wonderful six days here. Highly recommended!

As advertised - clean, nice location, easy self check in. The host was easy to communicate with and it was well worth the price paid to stay here. There was a bunch of cute cats in the neighbourhood and a really nice little cafe just down the street called “Cafe Ma”.
Would definitely consider staying here again should I find myself in Istanbul again

The room was a great size in a quiet neighborhood. Chris was extremely helpful and all instructions given were clear. The wifi was excellent and easy to connect to. It was within working distance to the metro. Our stay was comfortable and I would highly recommend.

İstanbul’a her gelişimde gönül rahatlığıyla kaldığım bir yer. Oda ve banyo son derece temiz, düzenli ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey düşünülmüş. Konumu hem merkezi hem de sakin; şehirde olmanıza rağmen gerçekten dinlenebiliyorsunuz. Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve iletişimi her zaman hızlıydı. Kendimi her seferinde evimde gibi hissediyorum. İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimde yine ilk tercihim olacak. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

the view! the breeze from the windows! we loved staying here. it's a bit of an uphill trek to get to, which is to be expected given the panorama! a bit bare bones (also expected given the incredible price) but super clean. Chris is extremely responsive. a tram stop and buses are just down the street—it's very easy to get to eminonu; balat and its lovely cafés are within walking distance. would absolutely stay again. thank you!

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located in Fenerbahce,Kadıkoy.
It’s located on Asian side of Istanbul. Near the sea shore, easy transportation access
5 min to walk Marmaray train station,
Near the Bagdat street(walking in 3 mins)
Close beach side, marina,parks, restaurants,shops,markets,hospitals( walking distance)
10mins to Kadikoy,
20mins to Europe side,
35 mins to Sabiha Gokcen Airport,
1 hour to Istanbul Grand Airport,
Our flat has an unique decoration.

reviews.text: Melda was responsive and nice. The apartment is located in a nice neighborhood. Kitchen has everything you would need. However, the apartment was a bit dirty. The apartment was very hot, fans were very noisy.

The apartment is conveniently located being few minutes away from Bagdat Street and free parking lot saved us a lot of time in crowded Istanbul streets.The apartment was spacious but old which seemed like it hasn’t been taken proper care of for a while.There was water leakage in one of the toilets,coffee machine was unusable due to lime and wifi was working at 1mbph speed blocking us from any remote work.On top of all this,few items that were listed under amenities were missing completely. No microwave in the kitchen,no mosquito nets,no real room darkening shades…(the room darkening shades in the master living room barely fit to the window leaving the room in complete sunlight especially in early hours)Our host was kind and seemed trying to help but she did not solve most of our problems and after a while stopped answering calls completely.I highly recommend double checking all amenities before arriving.Overall we weren’t very happy with our stay and I don’t think we are coming back.

Melda's place was a dream come true! We were warmly greeted by her mother, Fatos, setting the tone for an exceptional stay. The home is cozy, clean, and conveniently located just a 2-min walk from Bagdat Street's lively scene. The picturesque sea-side restaurants nearby were a delightful bonus. If you want to feel like a local while enjoying comfort and charm, this is absolutely the place for you. A memorable five-star experience!

We stayed here for a few days before a wedding. The location was a great value, clean and spacious for the three guests. Our host was extremely helpful and communicative which is helpful when traveling to a new city/country.

Her sorumuzun cevabını hızlı şekilde aldık. Ev çok rahat,konforlu temizdi. Her tür ihtiyacı sağlayacak mutfak eşya ve gereçleri ve ev eşyaları eksiksiz,kullanışlı, temizdi. Fotoğrafta göründüğünden bile daha iyi bir evle karşılaştık. Muhit ve konum olarak nezihti.Ailemle tekrar gelmeyi isteyeceğim bir evdi. Melda Hanıma teşekkürler

description: This stylish flat is located in one of Istanbul's most vibrant and touristic neighborhoods. Just a 5-minute walk to Taksim Square and only 2 minutes to Istiklal Street! The street itself is lined with charming local restaurants and cozy cafés. Public transportation, including metro and buses, is just a 5-minute walk away. Whether you want to dive into Istanbul’s lively nightlife or soak in its rich culture, this central location offers the perfect stay!

reviews.text:
Cagris apartment is comfortable and super central and you feel like home when you arrive. Even in the nighttime it was quite.
Badroom and Bedroom is super clean, kitchen was ok, but well equipped.
I totally enjoyed the big sunny balcony where you can see the kids play in the school nearby.
Communication with Cagri is fast and easy.
Internet worked fine.
It is in the 3th floor with round steps.

Clean comfy place with a terrace in a great location—minutes from Istiklal & Taksim, yet located at a peaceful street with some nice local cafes downstairs. AC, heater & WiFi were good.
Cagri was super responsive and accommodated us perfectly last minute. Everything went smooth and we had a perfect stay.

Cagri’s flat was a home from home, which is fantastically located (5 mins walk from the middle of Istiklal street). The flat was comfortable, well equipped. The balcony was a wonderful bonus. Cagri was an excellent host, responsive, responsible and accommodating.
Staying in a place like this has really improved our overall experience of the city.
The only downside is that it’s a walk up 4 flights of stairs which won’t suit everyone, but the listing made that clear and we were ok with that because of the convenient location.

A fantastic stay, the apartment is very well equipped and have a lovely style. Cagri is an artist and there are some masks and pieces of work by her. I liked the small details as well. The apartment has its own soul which makes you feel really comfortable. If you want to stay in the heart of Istanbul, the location is really perfect! This is a lively area with some cozy cafes and restaurants around. We had a great experience. It has a very nice terrace and in the evening it is really good to have some fresh air and grab a drink there. The hosts are very attentive and cooperative. I fully recommend this apartment!

This is a very well designed, comfortable apartment. The location is very easy to have access to anywhere. Cagri is very helpful and answers very quickly. I will definitely stay here again..Thanks for all guys!

description:
Our apartment is in very quiet and lovely area in Cihangir. 7-8 stairs down from enterance, 2nd floor from living room with big balcony. Receives a lot of light all day long.
