In the kitchen you will find everything you need to cook. Surrounded many restaurants and markets. 12 minutes to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, Galata Tower by walk. Also very close to Karakoy / Galataport, Tophane.
Enjoy Netflix with high speed wifi.

reviews.text: I stayed for 3 weeks and absolutely loved this eclectic, artsy gem in Cihangir. Between Galataport and Taksim, it was the perfect base for exploring Istanbul. The apartment was spacious and full of light, with parque floors, ivy on the patio, visits from kittens, and views of the sea and minarets. The full kitchen, comfy beds, and peaceful garden-level rooms made it perfect for rest or work. I loved walking home from Taksim through music, food, and a cat sanctuary. The hosts were incredible—kind, patient, and generous, even offering a refund when the fridge broke. We stayed because we loved it too much to leave! Don’t miss Cuppa, Casius Antioch Kitchen, Norm Coffee, Journey, and Tomtom Kebap nearby. Tip: skip the broken stairs near Cihangir Camii—take the ones by İlyas Çelebi Cami instead. A soulful, comfortable stay I’d return to in a heartbeat.

We had a wonderful stay at Zen’s place. The apartment is located in the beautiful neighborhood of Cihangir, with easy walking access to Taksim and also access to Galataport, though the route involves many stairs, which may be difficult for someone with knee pain. The house felt very comfortable and truly like home for our family, with everything we needed for our stay. The only small note is that the coffee maker shown in the photos was not available in the house. Other than that, everything was great. Zen is a lovely host, very welcoming, respectful, and kind, especially toward our son. We really appreciated her warmth and hospitality.

A rustic style appartment in a great location with helpful and friendly hosts.
Unfortunately the whole place feels very dated and poorly cared for. The sofas and chairs are on their very last legs, the kitchen and utensils hadn’t been properly cleaned, and the windows in the bedrooms look out onto car exhausts. Lots of missing light bulbs and things like the ceiling fan not working.
Would stay again if a bit of care was put into refurbishment and repair.

The best thing about this place is its location. Very walkable to a bunch of restaurants, Istiklal, and public transport stops. Zen is a great and responsive host. The place is quite simple, with old furniture, some loose outlets and sometimes just lightbulbs for lamps. Bedrooms windows are at the street level with cars parked right outside the windows. It was pretty quiet at night during our stay, but when I went to bed early after the flight, I could hear people talking and cars parking outside the bedroom window. Good thing I had my earplugs. Other than that, it was a good place to stay and it was very nice to sit on the balcony in the morning.

We had a fabulous stay at Zens place. It was in a great location due to being a quiet area but within walking distance of all we needed. Everything was as described. Very spacious. The apartment was really well equipped. We loved to unwind in the lounge before bed for an hour with a coffee after a taxing day sightseeing. We walked everywhere from here. To access local transport was also easy. I had a couple of queries whilst there (not related to anything going wrong) and the response was wonderfully speedy. We can highly recommend staying here if you are in Istanbul for a few days.
As a tip, if you make your own way from the airport do Taksim then Funicular and the tram to Tophane, this way you can get to the property by way of a gentler sloping road rather than hills and stairs. Be prepared for a lot of hills in Istanbul.

description:
The prominent details in the apartment are two TVs and two air conditioners. There is also a large comfortable double bed and a large long sofa in the living room. There is a kitchen and kitchen utensils for guests to cook in the apartment.

The apartment has been designed for the disabled and the location of the apartment is on the ground floor. Guests do not need to climb stairs.

reviews.text: In a very convenient location, the apartment is spacious and comfortable, with a big new and nice couch. It’s on the bottom floor and always smells somewhat like a damp basement unless the air conditioner is running. But overall very worth it. The hosts run a hotel just next door so are easily available and were very responsible and helpful.
Great host and great apartment. Very clean and comfortable. The host was very friendly and always keen to help.
The host is really nice - he helps to communicate with the driver on going to the place, and offers commute to the airport at a fair price. The toilet has some smells though.

Excellent location and great host!
Literally a 5 min walk from Taksim Square, metro and Istiklal street.
Nice location

description:
Stylish apartment with 24-hour security and elevator in the historical French Passage,
Only 10 steps to Galataport, Istanbul's most popular place for shopping, eating and drinking,
In the middle of Karaköy's best restaurants and entertainment venues, 100 meters from the old city square and all other historical locations, easy access by tram, right next to the Peninsula Hotel, 100 meters from the Istanbul Modern Museum in a great location.

reviews.text:
Fantastic location, within easy walking distance to the bus, tram and pier terminals. It is so centrally located, we are able to walk to Sultahnahmet and Galata districts. Melek is warm, helpful and responsive and quick to reply. Checking in and out was easy.
Apartment is located on 2nd floor with lift access and a 24-hour building manager, it is bright and clean, bedrooms are comfortable and cozy, kitchen is small. The surrounding area is full of restaurants and cafes and you can’t miss the huge new Galataport. We stayed during the weekdays and the apartment was quiet and peaceful.
Highly recommend, thank you for hosting us Melek.

The location is great but the place itself needs serious maintenance and mould removal. The photos must have been taken a while ago as the apartment is in poor condition with mould growing on the shower wall as well as some corners in the living room. There's lots of water damage from the ceiling and also bedding was not clean. The towels are old, utensils are missing in the kitchen and there are no basics for cooking such as salt, pepper etc. The coffee in the kitchen was also mouldy.
We left on our second day and got a full refund but this place should not be available on Airbnb until the remove the mould and clean it up. The location is the only great point about this place.

This apartment is in a prime location in the Karaköy neighborhood near the waterfront (Galataport) and within walking distance to great restaurants and cafés. It's tucked inside a charming passageway with local shops and coffee spots, which made for a gentle and welcoming entry into the city streets.
We appreciated that the apartment is at sea level — perfect after spending days exploring Istanbul’s many hills — and that there’s an elevator and a friendly doorman at street level, both of which made our stay easier.
Istanbul wakes up late and winds down late, so you can expect some street noise, especially on weekends. It didn’t bother us, but light sleepers may want to take note.
We were a family of three and the apartment worked well for us. I would happily stay here again and recommend it to others. Uğur is incredibly responsive and supportive — he made our stay smooth and easy.

Great location, near lots of attractions. This did make it quite noisy at night which may be something to keep in mind.
If using the pull out sofa bed in the living room, be aware that the curtains do not cover windows and so do not block out the light from restaurants at night, or sun early in the morning. This sofa bed option was a great way to accomodate our 5 guests during our stay.
Relatively clean however there were no clean sponges in the kitchen. We also asked for more Nespresso pods and reception noted they had run out. Nespresso machine was also unclean.
We appreciated the washing machine, however would be helpful to have a drying rack additionally.

I have stayed in bigger apartments and in major cities, I.e. Madrid, Barcelona, South Miami Beach and paid a lot less. This apartment should not cost more than $120.00 per night and this is at the high end. There were was an issue with the drainage in the only shower but because it was a Sunday, no one was able to take care till first thing Monday morning. Ugur was very responsive and apologetic about this issue. The place is right in the heart of dozen or so restaurant/bars and for this reason very noisy but nothing that a good pair of earplugs can’t fix. Overall good place to stay and walkable to everywhere! Price again, a little steep. Shower needs a better cleaning it had mildew.

description:
3 bedrooms, living room, kitchen, bathroom and balcony.

Bedroom 1 has fan.
Bedroom2 has AC.
Bedroom3 has AC.
Living room has AC.

On the 3rd floor. There is a lift in the building. There are 10 stairs outside the building to reach the main entrance of the building.

Smart TV, high speed wifi, washing machine, dryer, iron & iron board, hair dryer.

Fully equipped kitchen with stove, kettle, tea maker, fridge, dishwasher.

In the centre of Besiktas. Easy access to touristic locations.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The location is fantastic—easy access to the metro, taxis, and public transportation, making it super convenient to explore the city. The apartment had everything we needed, including linens, towels, a washer and dryer, a heater, and a fully equipped kitchen. It’s also close to great restaurants and the seashore, perfect for sightseeing. The hosts were excellent, providing clear instructions on how to get to the apartment and check in. The place was just as described in the listing and the pictures, and it was spotlessly clean. We were even greeted with sweet treats and water, which was such a thoughtful touch. I would highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Istanbul!

Our stay at this AirBnB was mixed. The location is amazing - near all of the Beşiktaş transport connections. However, being on a busy road, it’s also very noisy.
We found that the apartment doesn’t look much like the pictures advertised, unfortunately. Everything is looking a little worse for wear and quite worn. For example, the sofas are broken and stained, the mattress on one of the beds was broken and very uncomfortable, the pillows for each of the beds were lumpy and uncomfortable, the towels are very old and worn. The AC in the living room (which gets direct sunlight and therefore gets extremely hot) does not work properly. Further, the kitchen amenities are very basic. We let one of the property managers know about some of these issues and he kindly came round very quickly to try and sort them out. There weren’t enough cups or cutlery for each of us so he brought extra which was great, but wasn’t able to fix the AC issue. Overall, we would likely not stay here again.

The apartment was very clean, well-equipped, and comfortable for 6 people. Great location with easy access to the port and bus station. The kitchen was well-equipped, the air conditioning worked well, and we loved the large windows, beautiful scenery, and cozy balcony. The host was also responsive.
Unfortunately, we had some significant issues during our stay. There was no warm/hot water for 6 days, which was a major inconvenience. We also had a drainage problem in the bathroom, with water remaining on the floor after showers or even washing hands, requiring us to use a T-shaped floor squeegee.
Overall, the apartment has many positives, but these basic facility issues significantly affected our stay. Hopefully, they will be fixed for future guests.

We stayed few nights in this place. It was my best experience in Airbnb. The location was great! It is close to Besiktas Bazaar and you have access to many Cafes and restaurants. It is also close to bus station and ferries. We arrived a little bit earlier than check in time and we had a chance to leave our luggages there. The house was super clean, the beds were comfortable. The price was affordable. Enes answered my questions quickly (in 1 minute). If you are looking for a nice place to stay, I highly recommended!
Thanks Enes and Mustafa !

Communication with Seckin and Enes was excellent. The location of the house is great and every need is within walking distance. The apartment has an elevator and it is easy to carry luggage. Self-entry is in the lock box on the door. Inside, you will find gifts designed for you. The cleaning and heating of the house is very good. There is a water heater in the bathroom and when you stay with a large group you have to wait for it to heat up. The house decoration and the Bosphorus view are beautiful. We had an enjoyable time and will stay again when I come back.

description:
We have other 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom apartments available for our guests. All our apartments have a high review score.

“Taksim360 Beyoglu” is a very prestigious new project in Taksim. It consists of residential and commercial units such as Canopy by Hilton.

Enjoy a stylish experience in our apartment. The building has 24/7 security, free carpark and is within a 7 minute walk to Taksim Square, Taksim Metro Station and Istiklal Street.

reviews.text: We had a great stay at Ibrahim's apartment. The apartment was well located, close to Taksim Square and Istiklal St, well connected transport links and walkable, great restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was well appointed and we were able to feel at home, the bed was comfy, the apartment was clean and as described, I thought it was actually better than the photos. There was 24 hour manned security for the building and street. Ibrahim was very welcoming, friendly and helpful. He was very responsive to any queries we had. Very thoughtful providing free 19l water bottle and other provisions. Before accepting our booking, Ibrahim made us aware that the development was still in progress, whilst you could see that it was going on, not in the slightest did it disturb us, we never heard a single thing from the works. Would totally recommend and would stay again.

The apartment matches the description and photos - the complex is new and in good condition, there are security workers 24/7 at the entrance. The apartment itself is new, clean, there is everything you need in terms of utilities. However, since there are ongoing constructions, we have faced some problems like a light blackout and problems with internet, when the router turned off completely. Luckily, we bought a sim card and were able to contact Ibrahim and tell about the problem and he was very responsive and helpful, he called a master and the next day the internet was fixed for us. On the moment of our stay - february 2024, there was a big ongoing construction and the windows of the apartment faced it directly, with workers walking there all the time, which was not so pleasant, especially from the bedroom. The neighborhood itself is also quite scary. However, besides the construction moments, Ibrahim is an amazing and responsive host and overall we enjoyed our stay at the apartment!

After staying 12 nights in Ibrahim’s other apartment, we happily stayed an extra 2 nights in this one. It was just as clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, with all the same thoughtful touches and cosy underfloor heating. Once again, everything we needed was provided — from kitchen essentials like coffee, tea, and condiments, to bathroom amenities including shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. There were also plenty of towels, extra linen, and those lovely little touches like slippers that made the stay feel extra comfortable. The building is quiet and secure, and the location in Beyoğlu is perfect for exploring Istanbul.
